title: Personal Brand Manager + Executive Assistant
description:
ABOUT US



We're a UK investment company led by a founder with a growing public profile — author, investor, active on LinkedIn. The brand drives the business: it's how deals, press, and opportunities find us. Your job is to run the machine behind it so the founder only does the things only he can do.



You'll report directly to the founder. Small team, fast-moving, long-term role — we want someone who grows with us over years, not months.



THE ROLE



One person, three hats:



1. LinkedIn & Personal Brand (50%)



Own the content calendar: schedule posts from the founder's drafts and voice notes, keep the pipeline full

Repurpose content: turn long posts into shorter ones, pull quotes into Canva graphics (to our brand guidelines — templates provided)

Manage the inbox: triage DMs and connection requests daily, flag high-value conversations, draft replies for approval

Engagement: monitor comments on our posts and draft responses; track target accounts we should be engaging with

Report weekly: followers, impressions, top posts, DM conversations opened



2. PR & Visibility (20%)



Monitor Qwoted (and similar journalist-request platforms) daily for relevant opportunities

Draft pitches in the founder's voice for his approval — speed matters, these expire fast

Track placements and maintain an up-to-date press kit and bio



3. Executive Assistant (30%)



Morning briefing prepared before the UK day starts (you're 7 hours ahead — use it)

Diary management: protect focus blocks, schedule calls, chase confirmations

Track open commitments — his and yours — and chase them until closed

End-of-day report: what shipped, what's stuck, what needs a decision

Ad-hoc research and document prep



The golden rule: you draft, he approves. Nothing is published or sent in the founder's name without his sign-off. As trust builds, you'll earn autonomy — but his voice is the asset, and we protect it.



MUST-HAVES



2+ years managing LinkedIn or social presence for a founder, executive, or personal brand — with results you can show

Exceptional written English. You'll be drafting in a UK founder's voice for an audience of UK business owners — samples will be required and tested

Canva proficiency (working to an existing brand guide)

Scheduling/analytics tools: Taplio, Hypefury, Buffer, Shield, or similar

Rock-solid discretion — you'll see deals, numbers, and conversations that stay private

Self-managing: you flag problems with a proposed fix, not just the problem

Stable internet, backup power/connection, quiet workspace



NICE-TO-HAVES



Qwoted, HARO/Connectively, or Featured pitching experience

Newsletter tools (Beehiiv, Substack, Mailchimp)

Basic video editing (CapCut/Descript) for repurposing

Zapier/Make/n8n

Experience supporting an executive's calendar and inbox



HOURS



Monday–Friday, 8 hours/day. Mostly your daytime (PH), but your shift must run until at least 6:00 PM Philippine time so we get a live handover during the UK morning. Weekends are yours.



PAY & BENEFITS



13th month pay

Paid Philippine public holidays + paid leave after probation

Performance review at 6 months with a raise path

Stable, long-term role with one employer



HOW TO APPLY



Attention to detail and writing ability ARE the job. So:



Put the word SIGNAL as the first word of your application.

Answer these three questions (short answers, no essays):



Link to a LinkedIn account or personal brand you've managed — or describe what you did and the results, with numbers.

Writing test: a business owner comments on one of our posts: "Interesting, but I'd never sell my company to an investor." Write the 2–3 sentence reply you'd draft for the founder.



What time (PH) would you prefer to start and finish?



Include a 2-minute Loom or video introducing yourself in English — talk about brands and executives you've supported, not your life story.



Attach your CV and 2–3 writing samples (posts, DMs, or pitches you've written for someone else).

title: DaVinci Resolve Video Editor & Colorist
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



This is NOT a basic short-form clipping position.



If the majority of your experience is:



Podcast clips

CapCut/template-based editing

Generic TikTok/Reels edits

Animated captions + random B-roll + zooms

Replicating the typical "Alex Hormozi" short-form editing style



this position is probably not for you.



We are specifically looking for an editor with strong professional post-production fundamentals, particularly colour grading, pacing and storytelling.



Colour grading is the #1 skill we are hiring for.



You must be genuinely comfortable grading professionally shot Log footage inside DaVinci Resolve. Applying a LUT and adjusting contrast/saturation is not what we consider colour grading.



Your portfolio must demonstrate this.



About Us



Aethon Studios is a marketing and media production agency based in Melbourne, Australia.



We operate as both a marketing agency and a professional production house, producing high-quality video content for businesses and organisations.



Our work ranges from polished cinematic/commercial productions to natural organic social content and direct-response Meta advertisements.



We care significantly about production quality, colour, storytelling, sound and attention to detail.



We're not looking to produce generic high-volume "content agency" edits.



The Role



We're looking for a full-time DaVinci Resolve Video Editor / Colorist to become part of our production team long term.



Most projects are short-form, generally 30–90 seconds, but the editing style varies significantly.



One project might be a highly polished 60-second commercial with cinematic visuals, detailed sound design and carefully constructed pacing.



The next might be a talking-head organic video that should feel completely natural and barely edited.



Another might be a paid Meta ad where retention, hook delivery and clarity matter more than cinematic presentation.



A strong editor needs to understand the difference.



We do not want somebody who applies the same editing formula to every video.



Your Responsibilities



You will:



Edit high-quality short-form social media content

Edit cinematic/commercial-style videos

Edit natural organic content without unnecessarily over-editing it

Edit direct-response Meta advertisements

Occasionally edit longer-form content

Assemble footage from multiple takes, cameras and angles into one cohesive narrative

Professionally colour grade footage in DaVinci Resolve

Match shots accurately across different cameras, angles and lighting conditions

Create dynamic captions natively in Resolve

Perform detailed sound design

Select appropriate B-roll where required

Use pacing, music/nasheed where applicable, silence and sound intentionally

Create clean, simple motion graphics in After Effects when required

Follow detailed production briefs accurately

Implement revision feedback precisely

Communicate proactively with our production team

Manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

#1 REQUIREMENT — COLOUR GRADING



This is the most important part of the position.



You should understand concepts such as:



Log footage and proper normalisation

Colour-managed workflows

CSTs / colour space transformations

Exposure correction

White balance

Skin tones

Shot matching

Primary and secondary corrections

Node-based grading workflows

Mixed lighting correction

Highlight and shadow control

Noise reduction where appropriate

Creating a consistent look across an entire project



You should be capable of taking professionally shot Log footage and producing a polished, consistent commercial result.



If your colour-grading experience consists mainly of applying LUTs or presets, please do not apply.



What We're Looking For



In order of importance:



1. Excellent Colour Grading



This is non-negotiable.



2. Pacing, Storytelling & Narrative Sense



You should understand why a cut is being made, not simply where to make one.



3. Editing Versatility



You need to know when a video should feel cinematic and when the editing needs to disappear completely.



4. Advanced DaVinci Resolve Skills



Our post-production workflow is Resolve-based.



We are not looking for a Premiere-only editor.



5. Strong Sound Design



Sound should be treated as an important part of the edit, not an afterthought.



6. After Effects



Basic/intermediate AE skills are sufficient. We mainly require clean motion graphics and simple animations rather than complex VFX.



7. Communication



You need to be responsive, clear and proactive.



8. Reliability & Time Management



We produce a significant amount of content. Deadlines and consistency matter.



DO NOT APPLY IF



Please do not apply if:



You primarily edit using CapCut

You only know Premiere Pro and are not experienced in Resolve

Your portfolio consists mainly of podcast clips

Your main editing skill is captions, B-roll and transitions

You depend heavily on templates or presets

You cannot confidently grade Log footage

You use LUTs as a substitute for colour grading

You cannot explain your colour-grading workflow

You apply essentially the same editing style to every short-form video

You struggle to follow detailed instructions

You are looking to take on this position alongside several other full-time jobs



We would rather receive 20 highly relevant applications than 200 generic applications.



Compensation



AUD $1,500/month — Full-Time



Plus:



Performance-based bonuses

Long-term position

Opportunity for increased responsibility as the production team grows

Opportunity to work across professionally produced commercial and social projects



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the agency rather than simply complete individual editing tasks.



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.



The very first word of your application must be:



Aethon



Then provide the following:



1. Your Best Colour-Grading Example



Send a direct link to the specific video you believe demonstrates your colour-grading ability best.



Tell us:



What camera the footage was shot on, if known

What Log/gamma profile or colour space you worked with, if known

Whether you personally performed the entire grade

Briefly explain what you did to the footage

2. Your Best Cinematic / Commercial Edit



Send one direct link.



Do not send us an entire folder and ask us to find something.



3. Your Best Natural Organic/Social Edit



We specifically want to see whether you know how to make a good video without over-editing it.



Send one direct link.



5. Answer These Questions



A. How many years have you used DaVinci Resolve professionally?



B. When matching several shots filmed under slightly different lighting conditions, briefly explain how you approach getting them consistent.



C. What is one colour-grading mistake you regularly notice in social media videos?



D. What is the difference, in your opinion, between editing an organic social video and editing a paid Meta advertisement?



Keep your answers concise.



Important



Do not send us a generic cover letter.



We will be evaluating your work before your resume.



Applicants who demonstrate strong colour grading, storytelling and attention to detail will be shortlisted.



Shortlisted candidates will then complete a video editing trial using footage supplied by us before a final hiring decision is made.



If you've read and understood everything above, you already know what the first word of your application needs to be.

title: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper | Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines
description:
Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper

Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines





Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Engagement Type: Long-term Independent Contractor

Service Days: Monday to Friday

Reports To: Australian Client Manager

Client Contact: No direct client communication required



About the Role



We are an Australian accounting practice seeking an experienced Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support a portfolio of Australian clients.

This is a hands-on, non-client-facing role. You will work directly with an Australian Client Manager, who will manage all external client communication and provide instructions, priorities and review feedback.



You will be responsible for delivering accurate bookkeeping, payroll, BAS/IAS preparation, reconciliations, month-end work and accounting support across multiple Australian entities.

This opportunity is suitable only for candidates with substantial recent experience working within, or directly supporting, an Australian accounting firm, bookkeeping practice or public practice environment.



Key ResponsibilitiesBookkeeping and Reconciliations

· Manage end-to-end bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Complete bank, credit card, loan and merchant facility reconciliations.

· Reconcile payment platforms such as Stripe, Square, PayPal, Shopify and Wise.

· Process accounts payable and accounts receivable.

· Process supplier bills, sales invoices, credit notes, refunds and payments.

· Review aged receivables and aged payables.

· Process journals, accruals, prepayments and accounting adjustments.

· Reconcile director, shareholder, beneficiary and intercompany loan accounts.

· Maintain fixed asset registers and assist with depreciation schedules.

· Investigate unreconciled, duplicated, missing or incorrectly recorded transactions.



Account Code and GST Code Review



This is a senior-level role. You must be able to review the quality and technical accuracy of bookkeeping work.



You will be required to:



· Review and correct account codes.

· Review and correct GST tax codes.

· Identify incorrect use of GST on Income, GST on Expenses, GST-Free, Input Taxed and BAS Excluded codes.

· Review the GST treatment of overseas transactions, exports, reimbursements, disbursements, insurance payments and government grants.

· Identify personal, capital, private and non-deductible transactions.

· Review general ledger accounts for unusual balances and incorrect classifications.

· Review suspense, clearing and uncategorised transaction accounts.

· Self-review all work before submitting it to the Client Manager.

· Review work prepared by junior bookkeepers where required.



Australian Payroll



· Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payroll.

· Set up and maintain employee payroll records.

· Process ordinary hours, overtime, allowances, bonuses, deductions and reimbursements.

· Process annual leave, personal leave and termination payments.

· Prepare Single Touch Payroll reporting and year-end STP finalisation.

· Calculate and reconcile PAYG withholding.

· Calculate and reconcile employer superannuation.

· Review superannuation clearing house payments and identify rejected or unpaid amounts.

· Reconcile payroll reports, payroll journals and payroll liability accounts.

· Assist with payroll tax, workers compensation and other payroll compliance requirements.



BAS, IAS and Compliance Support



· Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for internal review.

· Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalment accounts.

· Review GST reporting under both cash and accrual methods.

· Reconcile BAS figures to the general ledger.

· Identify prior-period errors and transactions requiring GST adjustments.

· Assist with PAYG instalment variation calculations.

· Assist with Taxable Payments Annual Reports.

· Prepare supporting documents and schedules for the firm’s accountants and tax agents.

· Monitor internal deadlines and escalate missing information promptly.



Month-End and Year-End



· Complete monthly, quarterly and annual bookkeeping files.

· Reconcile all material balance sheet accounts.

· Review payroll, GST, superannuation and PAYG liabilities.

· Prepare accruals, prepayments and other adjusting journals.

· Review accounts payable and accounts receivable cut-off.

· Reconcile fixed assets, inventory and cost of goods sold where applicable.

· Prepare year-end workpapers and supporting schedules.

· Ensure client files are ready for financial statement and income tax return preparation.



Financial Reporting



· Prepare Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

· Prepare cash flow and management reports where required.

· Compare results with prior periods, budgets or forecasts.

· Identify unusual movements, negative balances and potential accounting errors.

· Provide clear internal explanations and supporting schedules to the Client Manager.



Tax Return Experience – Highly Regarded, but not essential



Experience preparing Australian income tax returns or tax workpapers is not essential but will be a strong advantage.



Relevant experience may include:

· Individual and sole trader tax returns.

· Company tax returns.

· Trust tax returns and distribution workpapers.

· Partnership tax returns.

· Rental property schedules.

· Depreciation and capital allowance schedules.

· Tax reconciliation workpapers.

· Xero Tax, MYOB Practice, HandiTax or BGL.



Essential Experience and Skills



Applicants must have:

· At least five years of recent Australian public practice bookkeeping experience.

· Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Advanced practical experience using Xero.

· Strong practical experience using MYOB.

· Strong practical experience using QuickBooks Online.

· Experience preparing BAS and IAS workpapers.

· Strong knowledge of Australian GST and account coding.

· Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting GST codes.

· Strong Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience.

· Advanced reconciliation and problem-solving skills.

· Experience preparing month-end and year-end workpapers.

· Excellent written and spoken English.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

· The ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.

· High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct.

· Ability to use AI tools



Experience limited to internal bookkeeping for one Australian business may not satisfy the public practice experience requirement.



Qualifications



The following qualifications are highly regarded:

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce.

· Diploma or recognised qualification in Accounting or Bookkeeping.

· CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent studies.

· Xero Advisor Certification.

· MYOB or QuickBooks certification.



Software



You must be confident using:



· Xero

· MYOB

· QuickBooks Online



Independent Contractor Arrangement



This is an independent contractor opportunity and not an employee position.



The contractor will:



· Provide services remotely from the Philippines.

· Provide their own computer, secure workspace, internet and backup power arrangements.

· Be responsible for their own business registration, taxation, invoicing and insurance obligations.

· Issue a valid monthly contractor invoice.



The contractor will ordinarily provide services Monday to Friday and maintain regular overlap with Australian business hours.



The parties will agree on a daily core collaboration window for meetings, questions and internal communication. Outside that window, the contractor may arrange their own working schedule, provided all deadlines and service requirements are met.



Timesheets and Work Records



The contractor must complete a daily timesheet recording:



· Date.

· Client or entity.

· Task performed.

· Time spent.

· Work completed.

· Outstanding issues and next steps.



Timesheets are used for client costing, workflow management, capacity planning and supporting the contractor’s invoice. They are not intended to operate as employee attendance records.

Remote Work Requirements



Applicants must have:



· A reliable computer or laptop.

· Stable high-speed internet.

· Backup internet.

· A quiet and secure home office.

· A suitable headset for online meetings.

· The ability to use multi-factor authentication and secure password systems.

· A strong commitment to privacy, confidentiality and data security.



How to Apply



Please submit:

· Your current resume.

· A brief cover letter of your Australian public practice experience.

· Details of your Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks Online experience.

· Details of your BAS, IAS and Australian payroll experience.

· Details of any Australian tax returns you have prepared.

· Your expected monthly contractor fee in Philippine pesos.

· Your earliest available commencement date.

· Confirmation of your internet.

· Confirmation that you can issue invoices as an independent contractor.



Pay: Php60,000.00 - Php70,000.00 per month

FitBeat is a personal training and outdoor fitness business based in Singapore. We help people get stronger, fitter and healthier through Personal Training, small group training and fitness programmes.

We are looking for a highly motivated remote sales person to join our team and focus purely on generating and converting sales.



The Role

This is a sales only position.

Your job is simple:

Find leads → Start conversations → Follow up → Book appointments → Close sales → Generate revenue

You will be selling our Personal Training packages and fitness services to potential and existing clients.

You will work remotely from the Philippines and communicate with prospects primarily through WhatsApp, Instagram,
 and other online channels.



Your Responsibilities

Follow up with new FitBeat enquiries quickly

Contact and engage potential customers

Follow up consistently with people who have shown interest but have not purchased

Reach out to old and inactive leads

Identify potential PT clients

Explain our services and pricing clearly

Handle common objections, especially around price, time and commitment

Book consultations and assessment sessions

Close PT package sales

Follow up with prospects until they make a decision

Reactivate previous leads and clients

Keep accurate records of conversations and sales

Report your activity and results regularly



What You Will NOT Be Doing

This is not a general Virtual Assistant position.

You will not be responsible for:

Social media management

Content creation

Canva/design

Administrative tasks

Coaching

Programming

Customer service

General operations

Your responsibility is sales and sales only. You get us the consultations, the founders will jump on a call and sell.

Confident communicating with people

Naturally persuasive without being pushy

Highly motivated by commission and results

Comfortable with outbound sales

Comfortable following up repeatedly

Excellent written English

Experienced in sales, lead generation, appointment setting or closing

Self motivated and able to work independently

Comfortable using WhatsApp, Instagram,
 and CRM systems

Reliable and organised

We would actually prefer a strong salesperson from another industry over someone from fitness who does not have real sales experience.



Experience in real estate, recruitment, SaaS, gym memberships, education, hospitality, telemarketing or other service based sales is highly relevant.

US$5/hour

10 hours per week

Sales conversion rate

Commission earned

title: Appointment Setter - Cold Calling for US B2B Cleaning Company
description:
We are a commercial cleaning company in New York City. We clean offices, medical practices, luxury retail stores, etc. We are hiring one appointment setter to call businesses and book walkthrough appointments for the owner.



This is a phone job. You will make 150 to 200 calls per day. If you do not like calling strangers, do not apply.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Call businesses from a list we provide. You will never build your own list.

Ask to speak to the person who handles cleaning.

Follow our script. Offer a free 20-minute walkthrough and quote.

Book the appointment directly on the owner's calendar.

Send a confirmation
, a reminder the day before, and a text the morning of.

Log every call in HubSpot.

Send a short report at the end of every shift with your numbers.



PAY

Target Pay: $1,000 (uncapped) = $700 per month base + $300 UNCAPPED commission (target of 20 monthly leads booked @ $15 per walkthrough)

title: Instagram DM Sales Rep (Sell by Chat) - Own the Whole Process
description:
JOB TITLE

Instagram DM Sales Closer (3+ Years) - Own Our Entire DM Sales Channel



TYPE OF WORK

Part time to start (15 hrs/week), moving to full time



SALARY

PHP 450 to 600 per hour depending on what you can prove, plus PHP 2,000 commission for every new member you sign, uncapped



HOURS

5 days a week inside 9:00am to 5:00pm Manila time (times are negotiable)





=====================================



READ THIS PART FIRST



This is not a message answering job and it is not a virtual assistant job. We are handing one person our entire Instagram sales channel and asking them to run it.



You will report to the founder, but will have complete ownership of the sales system. If you need to be told what to do each day, this role will not work for you and you should not apply.



We want someone who has done this for at least three years, who has their own opinions about what works, and who has proven results.





ABOUT US



We are a sports nutrition coaching business based in Sydney, Australia. We work with fighters. MMA, boxing, BJJ, judo, wrestling. Our job is to get them to their fight weight without wrecking their performance on fight night.



We run Instagram content and paid ads and we get a steady flow of new leads every week. Right now the founder handles those conversations between coaching calls, which means good leads go cold and most never get followed up.





HOW THE ROLE GROWS



You start part time on inbound only. Roughly the first 4 to 8 weeks, 15 hours a week. You learn our voice, our offer and our fighters, and you work only the leads who come to us: our free making weight calculator, our free ebook, ad leads in Leads Center, story replies and comment to DM. We start you here because we want you closing well before we scale your volume.



Once your numbers hold for two straight weeks, you move to full time and add outbound. That means 40 hours a week, keeping all the inbound, and going out to find fighters who already have a competition booked instead of waiting for them to find us. Hashtags, event pages, fight cards, gym accounts, our past clients, our old lead list and our workshop buyers.



Outbound is where this role gets interesting, because it is the half you get to design. We will tell you what our best clients look like. How you go and find more of them is your call.



The move to full time is based on your numbers, not on time served. We expect it to happen. If it does not, we hired the wrong person.





WHAT YOU OWN



Everything between a stranger seeing our content and a fighter paying us.



- Opening conversations, personalised to the human on the other end, never copy paste

- Qualifying properly, and letting go of the ones we cannot help quickly and politely

- Presenting the offer, handling objections, closing the sale

- Following up on a set cadence, not whenever you remember

- Reactivating our past clients and old leads

- Building and running the outbound side once you are full time

- Logging every conversation in the CRM with stage and outcome

- Owning the numbers, reporting them weekly, and telling us what the objections are saying about our offer and our ads



You will be given a proven script, an offer document, an objection bank and a library of real conversations that have already turned into sales. You are not starting from zero. But we expect you to improve on all of it. If our script is losing people at a certain point, we want you to tell us and rewrite it, not run it silently for six months.





WHAT YOU ARE NOT



You are not the coach. You will never give nutrition advice, weight cutting advice, training advice or anything medical. If someone asks a coaching question you get them excited about speaking to the coach and pass it up.



Any message about a weight cut in progress, an injury or anything clinical gets escalated to the founder straight away. We are a health business and this rule is not negotiable.





THE NUMBERS YOU WILL BE HELD TO



You see your own scoreboard and so do we. We review it every week.



While you are on inbound:

- First reply to a new lead: within 15 minutes during your shift

- New leads left untouched at end of shift: zero

- Opener to reply rate: 30% or better

- Reply to qualified conversation: 25% or better

- Qualified to offer presented: 60% or better

- Offer presented to sale: 25% or better

- Follow up compliance: 100% of open threads touched on cadence

- Minimum 10 sign ups per month (20k commission bonus per month)

- Conversations logged in CRM: 100%



Once you add outbound:

- New outbound conversations opened per day: 30 to 50

- Outbound targets who already have a competition booked: 70% or better



Inbound and outbound are tracked separately. They convert very differently and we do not want them blended.



For your first 30 days we hold you to the process and the volume, not the sales. After that, conversion is the job.





YOU WILL BE GREAT AT THIS IF



- You have 3+ years selling by chat and can show us the receipts, not just describe them

- You have owned a sales channel before, not just executed someone else's steps

- You are comfortable being ignored seven times out of ten and still showing up the next day

- You write like a real person. Short messages, real questions, no essays, no corporate tone, no obvious templates

- You already track your own numbers because you want to beat them

- You bring solutions. When something is broken you arrive with two options and a recommendation

- You can be trusted with our Instagram account and our brand voice without supervision





YOU WILL HATE THIS ROLE IF



- You want a manager checking in on you three times a day

- You want a fixed script you never have to think about

- You are uncomfortable telling the founder he is wrong about something

- You have only ever done customer support or admin work in an inbox





TOOLS



Meta Business Suite and Leads Center, ManyChat, Google Sheets. You must have used Business Suite and Leads Center before. 





WHAT WE OFFER



- PHP 450 to 600 per hour based on what you can show us you have done

- PHP 2,000 for every new member you sign, uncapped, from day one

- A 30 day ramp where we pay commission at target while you learn, so you are not out of pocket during training

- A clear, numbers based path from 20 hours to 40 hours, and we want you to get there fast

- A yearly budget for a sales course of your choosing

- Long term work with one client, direct access to the founder, and no layers in between

- Real room to grow. As this scales, the person in this seat runs the sales side and hires the next rep





HOW TO APPLY



Read this carefully. We reject anyone who misses a step, because following instructions is the first test of the job.



Start your message with the word CORNERMAN so we know you read the whole post.



Then send us:



1. A voice note, 60 to 90 seconds. Tell us why you would be good at this, and walk us through one sale you made entirely by chat, start to finish.



2. Two screenshots of real DM conversations you ran end to end. Cover the names. We want to see how you actually write.



3. Your numbers. Conversations per day, reply rate, close rate, and how you tracked them. If you do not have real numbers, say so honestly rather than inventing them.



4. A three message opener for this lead: a 24 year old amateur MMA fighter followed us after watching a reel and downloaded our free making weight calculator. He has not replied to anything yet. Write the exact first three messages you would send him.



5. One thing you would want to change or test in a DM funnel like ours in your first month, and why. Two or three sentences is plenty. This is the question we care most about.



6. Your available start date.



We want to move fast. Shortlisted applicants get a paid test project and then an interview with the founder. We want someone in the seat within two weeks.

title: Long Form Video Editor + Shorts Clipper (YouTube + Viral Reels)
description:
I run a short form content agency (Reels to Revenue) working with US business owners. I'm hiring ONE editor who does BOTH long form editing and clipping.



THE WORKFLOW: I film one long talking video (10 to 20 min). From each video you deliver:

1. One polished YouTube edit. Clean cuts, pauses removed, captions, zooms and b-roll to hold attention.

2. Around 10 short form talking-head reels clipped from that same video. You find the strongest 30 to 60 second moments, add hook text and burned captions, tight pacing. Vertical format, ready to post.



That is the job on repeat, every week, long term. You'll get raw footage in Google Drive and upload finished work back. Consistent volume, direct communication with me.



REQUIREMENTS:

- 2+ years editing experience, CapCut and/or Premiere Pro

- Portfolio REQUIRED: send 2 long form edits AND 3 reels/shorts you clipped from longer videos. Applications without both will not be reviewed.

- Strong English comprehension (you'll be picking hook moments from spoken content)

- Reliable internet, can start within 2 weeks



TO APPLY: Start your application with the word MANGO so I know you read this. Include your portfolio links and your monthly salary expectation.

title: Asterisk / FreePBX Engineer + Voice AI Integration (Full-Time)
description:
Start your application with the word TRUNK so I know you read this post.



I run two production Asterisk/FreePBX servers handling live inbound calls for US businesses. Several thousand DIDs across both. This is real traffic - when the PBX is down, revenue stops.



There are two halves to this job.



FIRST: fix what's broken. I have already completed a full technical audit of both systems. The findings are written up as issues in a private GitHub repo. You pick them up, diagnose, fix, test, push, and document what changed.



SECOND: build the after-hours voice AI. I want an AI agent answering calls on nights and weekends - capturing the caller's details, handling common requests, and escalating or taking a message when it can't. You'll design and build that integration into the existing PBX.



This role is telephony only. You will not touch my websites, CRM, or other applications. Your entire focus is the two PBX servers, the voice AI layer, and the backend code around them.



PART ONE - PBX ISSUE BACKLOG



- Working through an existing backlog of audited issues

- Inbound call routing: DIDs, inbound routes, IVRs, queues, time conditions, failover destinations

- Custom dialplan work where the FreePBX GUI cannot express the logic

- SIP trunk configuration and carrier troubleshooting

- Debugging call failures end to end - carrier SIP trace, Asterisk logs, AstDB, dialplan, database state, backend workers

- Blocking, rate limiting, and spam-protection logic

- CDR reporting and call-data queries



PART TWO - AFTER-HOURS VOICE AI AGENT



- Time-condition routing so calls go to the AI outside business hours and on weekends, and to the normal destinations during the day

- Getting call audio in and out of Asterisk to the AI service - AudioSocket, ARI externalMedia, or equivalent - with acceptable latency

- Handling interruption and barge-in so the caller can speak over the agent

- Warm transfer and escalation: the agent hands off to a human, a queue, or voi
 when it can't handle the call

- A fallback path so that if the AI service is slow or down, the call still gets answered. Callers must never hit dead air.

- Capturing what happened on the call - transcript, caller details, outcome - and pushing it somewhere useful

- Tuning the agent based on real call recordings, not assumptions



TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT



- Asterisk / FreePBX on Ubuntu

- chan_pjsip, SIP trunks (registration-based and IP-authenticated)

- Custom dialplan in extensions_custom.conf, AGI hand-offs

- Node.js backend services, PM2, Nginx

- PostgreSQL / MySQL, Redis

- Git / GitHub - issues, branches, pull requests

- Several thousand DIDs under management



REQUIRED



- You have administered a production Asterisk or FreePBX system with real inbound traffic. Not a lab, not a course, not a Twilio/Vapi integration on its own.

- Shell access comfort: asterisk -rvvvvv, pjsip set logger on, reading the full log, querying the CDR database

- You can write and debug dialplan by hand, not only through the GUI

- Comfortable on Ubuntu: systemd, Nginx, log files, firewall

- Node.js well enough to read, fix, and build backend services around the PBX

- Git workflow: branch, commit with a clear message, pull request

- You trace a problem to root cause before changing anything, and you can say which segment of the call path owns the fault

- Strong written English - every fix needs a written explanation



STRONG PLUS



- You have already connected an AI voice agent to a real phone system - Vapi, Retell, ElevenLabs, Deepgram, OpenAI Realtime, or a custom STT/LLM/TTS pipeline

- Real-time media streaming from Asterisk (AudioSocket, ARI externalMedia, EAGI)

- Carrier-side troubleshooting (codec negotiation, NAT/RTP, session timers)

- fail2ban and SIP security hardening

- AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor) used with judgment on real code

- Experience being the only telephony person in an organization



NOT A FIT IF



- Your VoIP experience is only Twilio, Vapi, or Retell rather than running a PBX yourself

- You have only used the FreePBX web interface and never edited a config file or read an Asterisk log

- You need task-by-task supervision

- You would test a change on a production system carrying live calls



PROCESS



Short call, then a PAID technical assessment on an isolated staging PBX (4-6 hours, paid at your rate). Long-term full-time position. References checked before any production access is granted. You will need 3-4 hours of daily overlap with US Central time.



TO APPLY - ANSWER THESE SIX QUESTIONS



Applications without answers will not be reviewed. Attach your resume and any GitHub or work I can look at - but an application with a resume and no answers will be ignored. Short and specific beats long and general.



Q1. Describe one real call-path problem you traced end to end. Where exactly did the call die, how did you prove it, and what did you change?



Q2. Inbound calls from one carrier have one-way audio. Every other trunk is fine. What are the first three things you check?



Q3. Calls are dropping at the same duration every time - always around 15 or 30 minutes. What is your first hypothesis and why?



Q4. How do you make a dialplan change on a PBX carrying live calls without dropping any of them?



Q5. What tables would you query in the CDR database to answer "how many calls hit this DID between these two timestamps, and how many were answered?"



Q6. How would you get live call audio out of Asterisk and into an AI voice service, and back to the caller? If you have built this before, tell me how. If you have not, tell me how you would approach it - I would rather have an honest plan than a bluff.

title: AI Video Producer (Higgsfield + ElevenLabs) — Pixar-Style Ads
description:
ABOUT US

We are a German Direct-to-Consumer brand in the women's health space. 

We produce 3D Pixar-style cartoon ads for Meta, TikTok, and Reels — 

NOT classic UGC, NOT talking-head ads. We create animated characters

production is AI-powered. (Brand name shared with shortlisted 

candidates.)



THE ROLE

You are the person who turns our prompts into finished ad clips. We 

give you everything pre-prepared: copy, image prompts, animation 

prompts, voice descriptions, and step-by-step SOPs (Standard Operating 

Procedures). Your job is the technical execution and final assembly.



We provide all tool logins (Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, etc.) — you don't 

need your own accounts.



???????????????????????????????????????

THE OPPORTUNITY

???????????????????????????????????????



Starting as PART TIME (around 20-30 hours per week) at $6-10/hour 

depending on experience. If you perform well in the first 4-8 weeks, 

we upgrade to FULL TIME with higher pay and lead producer 

responsibilities. We are looking for a long-term partner, not a 

one-off freelancer.



???????????????????????????????????????

YOUR DAILY WORKFLOW

???????????????????????????????????????



Step 1 — Generate images (Higgsfield)

You receive image prompts from us. You generate the start frames for 

each clip in 9:16 vertical, Pixar-style. If the result doesn't match, 

you iterate the prompt independently until it fits.



Step 2 — Generate animations (Higgsfield)

You take the approved image and the animation prompt and generate 

the video clip. You know how to troubleshoot when an animation looks 

"dead" or off.



Step 3 — Generate voice (ElevenLabs)

You generate German voice-over tracks in ElevenLabs. We provide the 

exact copy and voice description. You set Stability, Style, and 

Speaker Boost correctly. You export clean audio files per clip.



Step 4 — Lip-sync (Higgsfield)

You combine the animated character clip with the German ElevenLabs 

voice using Higgsfield's lip-sync feature. You verify the lip 

movements match the German audio and iterate if needed.



Step 5 — Final assembly (CapCut)

You edit everything together in CapCut:

- Lip-synced character animations + voice

- Captions in our brand style (we provide the style guide)

- 3 final hook variations per ad (same body, different openers)

- Export in 9:16, 1080x1920, optimized for Meta and TikTok



???????????????????????????????????????

MUST-HAVE SKILLS

???????????????????????????????????????



AI TOOLS (core of the job):

- Higgsfield AI — proven experience with image generation, video 

  generation, AND lip-sync. You know the interface, the prompt 

  patterns that work, and how to troubleshoot bad outputs.

- ElevenLabs — voice generation experience. You know how to adjust 

  Stability, Style, and Speaker Boost. You can export clean 

  per-clip audio files.

- CapCut Pro — clean cutting, caption styling, timing, export 

  settings for Meta/TikTok



TECHNICAL SKILLS:

- 9:16 vertical video format expertise

- Clean file management (clips, audio, finals named and organized)

- Connecting multiple AI tools in one workflow

- Lip-sync timing and audio-video synchronization

- Meta Ads and TikTok export settings



SOFT SKILLS:

- Self-directed iteration — when an image or animation doesn't fit, 

  you regenerate without asking. You can judge quality yourself.

- Eye for quality — you recognize when an animation looks "dead" 

  vs. alive, when lip-sync is off, when captions sit wrong.

- Fast turnaround — one complete ad (3 hook variations + 6 clips = 

  9 final clips) within 1-2 working days.

- Reliable communication — short progress updates, clear questions, 

  organized deliverables as download links.



LANGUAGE NOTE

You do NOT need to speak German. All copy and prompts come from us 

in German — you only need to copy-paste them correctly without typos. 

A German native speaker on our team reviews everything before launch.



???????????????????????????????????????

NICE TO HAVE

???????????????????????????????????????



- Experience with Kling AI, Runway ML, Pika Labs, or similar

- Experience with D2C/E-commerce ads (especially supplement, 

  health, or wellness niches)

- Motion graphics basics (After Effects)

- AI voice cloning experience for multi-voice projects



???????????????????????????????????????

WHAT YOU GET FROM US

???????????????????????????????????????



- Full ad copy (every word written out)

- Ready-to-use image prompts

- Ready-to-use animation prompts

- Voice description for ElevenLabs (Stability/Style settings 

  included)

- Caption style guide

- Step-by-step SOPs for every workflow step

- ALL tool logins (Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, etc.) — no need for 

  your own accounts

- Feedback within 24 hours on every clip



???????????????????????????????????????

HOW TO APPLY

???????????????????????????????????????



Send the following — applications missing any of these will not be 

reviewed:



1. SHORT LOOM VIDEO (max 3 minutes) showing you actually using an 

   AI video tool (Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, Pika — any of them). 

   Show the interface, your prompting style, and one finished output.



2. 1-2 EXAMPLES of AI-generated animations or videos you have made 

   (Google Drive or Vimeo links).



3. SHORT ANSWER (3-5 sentences): "When a Higgsfield animation comes 

   out looking 'dead' or stiff, what do you do to fix it?"



4. List of AI tools you use regularly.



5. Your hourly rate (between $6-10/hour).



6. Your weekly availability and time zone.



Applications without the Loom video will be skipped immediately.

title: Property Bookeeper & Administrator
description:
Position Title: Property Bookkeeper & Administrator

Location: [Your Location / Remote / Hybrid]

Employment Type: [Full-Time / Part-Time / Contract]

Reporting To: Business Owner / Operations Director

About the Role

We are an expanding property management and development business managing a portfolio of ~15 Houses in Multiple Occupation (HMOs) comprising roughly 90 individual rooms, alongside property maintenance and refurbishment projects.

We are bringing our property management in-house while onboarding third-party client properties. We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Property Bookkeeper & Administrator to take full ownership of our day-to-day financial operations. This role bridges general property accounting (rent reconciliations, landlord statements) and Construction Industry Scheme (CIS) compliance for our subcontractor workforce.

Key Responsibilities

1. HMO Property & Client Accounting

● Rent Tracking & Reconciliation: Monitor incoming rent payments for ~90 tenant rooms across multiple properties, matching payments promptly and resolving arrears.

● Client Landlord Statements: Generate accurate, timely monthly payout statements and invoices for third-party property owners, deducting management fees and maintenance costs.

● Tenant & Landlord Invoicing: Draft and dispatch monthly management fee invoices, tenant utility recharges, and deposit receipts.

2. CIS (Construction Industry Scheme) & Subcontractors

● Invoice Auditing: Review all subcontractor invoices to ensure clear, accurate split between Labour and Materials in line with HMRC guidelines.

● Deductions & Returns: Calculate CIS on labour, issue monthly CIS Payment Statements (vouchers) to subcontractors, and submit monthly HMRC CIS returns accurately and on time.

3. Core Bookkeeping & Financial Control

● Bank Reconciliation: Perform daily/weekly bank reconciliations across all business accounts.

● Purchase Ledger & Receipts: Process supplier invoices, receipts, and operational expenses, categorising them correctly by property/job for accurate cost tracking.

● Credit Control & Arrears Management: Keep tenant and client accounts up to date, actively chasing overdue rents or outstanding invoices.

● Financial Reporting: Assist business management with month-end reporting, cash flow tracking, and year-end audit preparation.

● Personal Expenses: Keep track of personal/director expenses/receipts

● Accounts queries: Answer questions from the external account regarding year end accounts

● Deadlines: Ensure all confirmation statements, accounts and tax returns filed on time

Key Requirements & Experience

● Property Finance Experience: Strong background in property bookkeeping, rent reconciliation, or estate/letting agency accounting (HMO experience is a distinct advantage).

● Accounting Software Proficiency: Hands-on experience with modern accounting platforms (e.g., Xero, QuickBooks) and property management software (e.g. Arthur online, Rentman, or similar).

● Attention to Detail: Ability to handle high-volume, low-value transactions (individual room rents) accurately.

What Would Make You Stand Out

● Prior experience transitioning outsourced property portfolios in-house.

● Familiarity with deposit protection schemes (TDS, DPS, MyDeposits).

● Understanding of HMO licensing structures and property cost allocation.

title: Claude Code/Codex Dev

We are looking for a capable and reliable developer who is experienced with **Claude Code and AI-assisted software development** to help finish an existing CRM system.



This is **not a project starting from scratch**.



The CRM is already substantially built and functional. I have been developing it myself using Claude Code, but I no longer have enough time to finish the remaining features, testing and polish.



Your job will be to take over the existing project, understand the current codebase, and use Claude Code to efficiently bring the CRM to a production-ready state.



## What You'll Be Doing



- Review and understand the existing CRM and codebase

- Work through a clear list of remaining features and issues

- Use Claude Code extensively to develop and troubleshoot

- Test features properly rather than simply accepting AI-generated code

- Fix bugs and edge cases

- Improve existing functionality where required

- Commit changes cleanly using Git

- Keep the existing architecture unless there is a genuine reason to change it

- Provide a short daily update showing what has been completed and any blockers



The goal is simple:



**Finish the CRM, make sure it works properly, and get it ready for everyday business use.**



## Who We're Looking For



You do NOT need to be a senior software engineer.



I am more interested in someone who is:



- Very comfortable using Claude Code

- Technically capable and able to understand an existing codebase

- Good at debugging

- Comfortable with Git/GitHub

- Able to test their own work

- Resourceful and able to solve problems independently

- Detail-oriented

- Reliable and communicative

- Comfortable taking ownership of a project and pushing it through to completion



Experience building internal tools, dashboards, CRMs or business applications is a big advantage.



## Important



We are specifically looking for someone who **actually uses Claude Code for development**, rather than someone who has only experimented with ChatGPT or other AI tools.



You should understand how to give Claude Code context, work through larger tasks, review its changes, debug problems, and prevent it from making unnecessary changes to an existing application.



## Initial Project



Your first project will be completing an existing CRM for a UK business.



You will receive:



- Access to the existing codebase

- An explanation of how the CRM currently works

- A list of remaining requirements

- Guidance on the intended finished product



From there, I want someone who can take ownership and make progress without needing constant supervision.



There may be ongoing development and automation work available for the right person after the CRM is completed.



## How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions in your application:



1. How long have you been using Claude Code?

2. What have you personally built using Claude Code?

title: ON-SITE CEBU CITY METRO, DAILY — Ops/Production Manager (Must Know Local Editors)
description:

We are a US-based media company that produces long-form YouTube content at scale. We are opening a small, dedicated editing office in Cebu City and we are looking for ONE strong manager to run it.



This is primarily a people-and-operations role, with hands-on editing as a backup skill — not a full-time editing job.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Recruit and build a team of 3-5 video editors here in Cebu City

- Manage the daily workflow: assign work, hold deadlines, keep quality consistent

- Train the team to our style and standards (we provide the system and the scripts)

- Judge editing quality and catch issues before they ship

- Step in and edit yourself when someone is out sick, or when something urgent needs to get done — not a daily requirement

- Manage the workspace, the equipment and attendance

- Report once a day to our team abroad — you are our person on the ground



THE 3-WEEK TARGET

What we mean by this: 3 weeks from your start date to having the office running with 3 editors actively working in it. That covers choosing the building, getting equipment set up, recruiting editors, and onboarding them — not 3 weeks until you personally walk through the door.



That said, quality matters more than hitting the number exactly. We would rather have week 4 with three good editors than week 3 with two good ones and one warm body rushed in to hit a deadline. The last two hires especially are judged on fit and quality, not just speed.



This is exactly why an existing network of editors in Cebu is a real advantage — recruiting from a cold start while also setting up an office in 3 weeks is genuinely difficult.



WHAT WE NEED

- ON-SITE IN CEBU CITY, EVERY WORKING DAY. This is not remote and not hybrid — if you cannot commit to being physically present every working day, please do not apply

- Experience as a team lead, lead editor, or someone who has supervised editors, managed workflow, or done QA/review on a team's output — tell us what that looked like

- Basic-to-solid hands-on video editing ability — enough to judge quality and step in when needed. You do NOT need to be a world-class editor or edit every day. Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects preferred. Tell us what software you use and share a portfolio/reel

- Based in Cebu City, or ready to relocate before starting

- Excellent English, written and spoken

- Comfortable with project management tools (ClickUp, Trello, Asana or similar)

- NBI clearance and at least 2 references we can actually call



NICE TO HAVE

- Recruiting or hiring experience

- Experience with YouTube content

- Experience working inside a seat-lease / BPO facility



WHAT WE OFFER

- PHP 55,000 - 70,000 per month depending on experience

- Full-time, long-term, on-site in Cebu

- You build your own team and grow with the office as it expands



HOW TO APPLY

Put the word CEBU at the top of your reply so we know you read this ad. Then send:

1. A short note about a team or workflow you led, supervised, or did QA on, and how many people were involved

2. Your CV and a portfolio or reel showing your own long-form YouTube editing work

3. Your answer to this question: how would you recruit 4 good video editors in Cebu within 3 weeks?



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a small paid test/trial task before a final decision.



Applications without the word CEBU at the top will not be reviewed.

title: Go High Level & Zapier - Automation Specalist
description:
Automation Specialist



The role



You own every connection between our systems: SalesKick, GoHighLevel, Hyros, 
, Whop and the pages we build in Lovable.



Leads, bookings, reschedules, cancellations, call outcomes and sales all have to move between those tools. Right now nobody is watching whether they do.



Three things are needed from you: keep the automations we have running, fix them when they break, and build the ones we do not have yet. The full list is below.



The software stack we use

GoHighLevel. -Workflows, triggers, pipelines, tags, custom fields, calendars, snapshots,
s.

SalesKick - Where calls get booked. Bookings, reschedules, cancellations and no shows all start here.

Hyros - Attribution and tracking, in both directions with GHL.


 - Setter dialling lists, fed from GHL pipeline stages.

Lovable - Funnel and landing pages, and the webhooks that fire out of them.

Zapier - The glue between everything that has no native integration.

Stripe -  Purchases, upsells and refunds flowing into the CRM.

Whop - Payment Processor 



What you will actually do



- Run a daily check that every critical automation fired as expected, and log it. You tell us it broke, we never tell you.

- Watch webhook failures and Zapier error queues. Catch, fix, replay, then fix the cause so it does not happen twice.

- Confirm every SalesKick booking lands in GHL with the right owner, tags and pipeline stage.

- Keep the sales team calendars honest. Availability open where it should be open, blocked where it should be blocked, no double bookings, no ghost holds left behind by a cancelled call. A prospect must never see a slot that is not real, and a closer must never lose a slot that is.



Connect it

- Build webhook triggers from SalesKick for reschedules and cancellations, so a moved call updates the pipeline stage, the dialler list and the calendar without anyone touching it.

- Push call and sale data from GHL into Hyros, and pull attribution back onto the contact record so source travels with the lead.

- Wire Lovable pages and Stripe purchases into GHL with the correct tags, custom fields and pipeline stage.

- Sync pipeline stages to 
 lists so setters always call the right people in the right order, with no manual admin.



Build it

- Build new automations from a written spec. Speed to lead, no show recovery, rebooking, abandoned checkout, buyer nurture.

- Improve tracking until every lead carries its source from first click through to cash collected.

- Document every automation you build. What fires it, what it does, where it can fail, how to test it.



Report it

- One page every week. What broke, what you fixed, what you built, what is at risk next.

- Raise numbers that do not reconcile before anyone else spots them.



Who you are

Required, and you will be asked to prove each one:



- Two years or more building inside GoHighLevel. Workflows, triggers, custom fields, pipelines, calendars, snapshots.

- Genuinely comfortable with webhooks and APIs. You can read JSON, fire a test payload in Postman, and work out what an error log is telling you.

- Zapier past the template level. Filters, paths, formatter, webhooks, error handling.

- Experience with a call tracking or attribution platform. Hyros preferred, others considered.

- Written English clear enough to report a failure precisely and ask a precise question.

- Able to work 9am to 5pm UK time, Monday to Friday, which is a late shift in the Philippines. Your own machine, stable internet, and a backup for both power and connection.



Counts strongly in your favour:



- Hyros specifically.

- Lovable, or another AI build tool, plus enough JavaScript to read what it produced.

- Claude or similar used as a real working tool. Tell us what you built with it.

- Stripe webhooks, Supabase edge functions, or anything else where you have debugged a payload rather than just connected an app.

- Whop and 
.



This role is wrong for you if you wait to be told something is broken, if you need a ticket before you act, or if you would rather report a problem than fix it.



How we will judge the first 90 days

Day 30. Know what we have.

A single document listing every automation, webhook, Zap, form and tracking script across GoHighLevel, SalesKick, Hyros, 
, Whop, Lovable and Zapier. For each one: what fires it, what it does, where it sends data, whether it is live or dead, and when it last ran.



Daily health check running and logged from week two.



Day 60. Make it reliable, and make it repeatable for clients.

Sales team calendars accurate with no manual fixes. A GoHighLevel snapshot we can deploy into a new client sub-account, with the standard automations and tracking already in it. One client build delivered end to end from that snapshot, documented well enough that the next one is faster.



Day 90. Data Verification.

90% or better agreement between GoHighLevel, Hyros and the dashboard on leads, calls booked, calls shown and cash collected. Measured weekly by reconciling the same week across all three, with any gap over 10% explained in writing.

Client onboarding down to a repeatable day of work: snapshot deployed, webhooks connected, tracking verified.

No silent failure running longer than 24 hours before you catch it.



Hours and pay



Full time, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm UK time.



$1,200 to $1,500 per month depending on experience, paid monthly. Reviewed at 90 days.



How to apply



Apply here: 
 



The form is the only way to apply to this role. Anything sent by
 or DM instead will not be read.

title: Video Editor For Dental Videos on YouTube
description:
I have 3 YouTube channels, and I need a new editor who uses DaVinci Resolve. I use a cloud-based team editing approach, which means you will need to learn to edit from proxy files and have the storage space to do it. I do about 3 videos a month. Each video pays $100 for videos under 15 minutes, and I offer up to $150 for longer videos; each video can also earn a bonus. Videos are usually about 7 to 14 minutes long.



REQUIREMENTS

1. YOU MUST USE DAVINCI RESOLVE and have a license to edit from the cloud.

2. After the paid trial, you will need 1.3 TB of AVAILABLE STORAGE SPACE for all the proxies.

3. You must deliver videos on time. 



BONUS: 

I also offer bonuses for videos that don't require much follow-up editing and are done on time. For example, if the video pay is $100 and I don't need many revisions, I offer a $30 bonus, for a total of $130 per video. 



TEAM EDITING PROCESS

My projects are based on team editing, so I can make edits and notes myself. So the process is probably different from what you're used to.



My process involves: 1- Downloading the proxies from my server. 2- Chopping up the A-roll. 3- Adding B-roll. 4- Adding graphics, text, Titles, Transitions, and Music. 5- Changing the revisions that I send.



THE KIND OF VIDEOS & PROJECTS: 

The current channel for this job listing is called Baseline Dental on YouTube; you should watch some of the videos already done on that channel. Once you have my process down and edit well, I have 2 other channels, and I will give you more projects for them to earn more. You can expect to make $350 to $400 per month at first, doing 3 videos a month. If you edit fast and on time, I will move you on to other projects, shorts, and possibly other channels. Then you can expect to make about $400 to $600 or possibly more.



Each video will take about 6 to 8 hours once you are used to the process. It may take longer at first. 



My other channels are called The Proposal and Brielle Buck. However, at first we will just be working with the Baseline Dental channel.



PAID TRIAL:

This paid trial and process will take a few days to learn and set up. But after that, everything will get easier.



I have current editors who have been working for me for 5 years. I have been on YouTube for over 8 years. So this can be a reliable long-term job for you. I hope you will be my next editor!



Please apply and respond if you have used DaVinci and can deliver videos reliably and on time. Talk to you soon!

This is more than a typical Product Research role. We’re looking for someone who can eventually help us build the system behind our product research process.



About Us



We are a growing Dutch e-commerce company selling on 
, one of the largest online marketplaces in the Netherlands and Belgium.



Our goal isn’t just to find winning products—we want to build a scalable product research system that consistently identifies great opportunities for our current wellness and intimacy brand and can later be applied to future product categories.



We’re looking for someone who wants to help build that system.



The Role



This role has two stages.



We first want to understand how you think and approach product research.

title: Asterisk / FreePBX Engineer — Production PBX (Full-Time)
description:
Start your application with the word TRUNK so I know you read this post.



I run two production Asterisk/FreePBX servers handling live inbound calls for

US businesses. Several thousand DIDs across both. This is real traffic - when

the PBX is down, revenue stops.



I have already completed a full technical audit of both systems. The findings

are written up as issues in a private GitHub repo. I need one person to work

those issues: pick them up, diagnose, fix, test, push, and document what

changed.



This role is telephony only. You will not touch my websites, CRM, or other

applications. Your entire focus is the two PBX servers and the backend code

around them.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



- Working through an existing backlog of audited issues on the PBX systems

- Inbound call routing: DIDs, inbound routes, IVRs, queues, time conditions,

  failover destinations

- Custom dialplan work where the FreePBX GUI cannot express the logic

- SIP trunk configuration and carrier troubleshooting

- Debugging call failures end to end - carrier SIP trace, Asterisk logs,

  AstDB, dialplan, database state, backend workers

- Backend Node.js services that interact with the PBX

- Blocking, rate limiting, and spam-protection logic

- CDR reporting and call-data queries

- Documenting every change and the reason for it



TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT



- Asterisk / FreePBX on Ubuntu

- chan_pjsip, SIP trunks (registration-based and IP-authenticated)

- Custom dialplan in extensions_custom.conf, AGI hand-offs

- Node.js backend services, PM2, Nginx

- PostgreSQL / MySQL, Redis

- Git / GitHub - issues, branches, pull requests

- Several thousand DIDs under management



REQUIRED



- You have administered a production Asterisk or FreePBX system with real

  inbound traffic. Not a lab, not a course, not a Twilio/Vapi integration.

- Shell access comfort: asterisk -rvvvvv, pjsip set logger on, reading the

  full log, querying the CDR database

- You can write and debug dialplan by hand, not only through the GUI

- Comfortable on Ubuntu: systemd, Nginx, log files, firewall

- Node.js well enough to read and fix backend services around the PBX

- Git workflow: branch, commit with a clear message, pull request

- You trace a problem to root cause before changing anything, and you can

  say which segment of the call path owns the fault

- Strong written English - every fix needs a written explanation



STRONG PLUS



- Carrier-side troubleshooting experience (codec negotiation, NAT/RTP,

  session timers)

- fail2ban and SIP security hardening

- AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor) used with judgment on real code

- Experience being the only telephony person in an organization



NOT A FIT IF



- Your VoIP experience is Twilio, Vapi, Retell, or another API platform

  rather than running a PBX yourself

- You have only used the FreePBX web interface and never edited a config

  file or read an Asterisk log

- You need task-by-task supervision

- You would test a change on a production system carrying live calls



PROCESS



Short call, then a PAID technical assessment on an isolated staging PBX

(4-6 hours, paid at your rate). Long-term full-time position. References

checked before any production access is granted. You will need 3-4 hours of

daily overlap with US Central time.



TO APPLY - ANSWER THESE FIVE QUESTIONS



Applications without answers will not be reviewed. Short and specific beats

long and general.



Q1. Describe one real call-path problem you traced end to end. Where exactly

did the call die, how did you prove it, and what did you change?



Q2. Inbound calls from one carrier have one-way audio. Every other trunk is

fine. What are the first three things you check?



Q3. Calls are dropping at the same duration every time - always around 15 or

30 minutes. What is your first hypothesis and why?



Q4. How do you make a dialplan change on a PBX carrying live calls without

dropping any of them?



Q5. What tables would you query in the CDR database to answer "how many calls

hit this DID between these two timestamps, and how many were answered?"

title: Cross-Channel AI Content & Marketing Specialist
description:

This role combines social media, content creation, video editing, SEO, analytics and AI automation. We are looking for someone who can create strong content, understand performance, and continuously look for ways to improve and automate marketing workflows using the latest AI tools.



AI is a core part of how we work. You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and interested in building AI-powered systems, automations and agentic workflows rather than using AI only for basic content generation.

This is not a short-term freelance project. We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our team and grow with the agency.



Your responsibilities

• Work with Local SEO and continuously learn and apply developments in AEO, AI Search and emerging search behaviour.

• Monitor performance using tools such as GA4, Google Search Console and platform analytics.

• Build AI automations, agentic workflows and repeatable systems using tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs and webhooks.

• Understand how Claude, ChatGPT and other LLMs can connect with tools, data and external platforms through APIs, MCP, skills or comparable technologies.

• Stay informed about new AI tools and proactively suggest ways to improve efficiency, quality and scalability.

• Support Google Ads, Meta Ads or other performance marketing activities where relevant.



Essential skills and experience

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, content creation or social media.

• Strong video editing skills are essential.

• Experience with CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar tools.

• Strong understanding of social media content and platform-specific formats.

• Strong written English and the ability to create engaging marketing content.

• Good understanding of SEO, content optimization and analytics.

• Hands-on experience using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or comparable AI tools.

• Experience with n8n, Make, Zapier or similar automation platforms.

• Understanding of APIs, webhooks and how different tools can be connected.

• Familiarity with AI agents, agentic workflows and modern LLM integrations.

• Strong curiosity about new AI tools, models and marketing technologies.

• Ability to think independently and improve processes rather than simply follow instructions.



Highly desirable experience

• Local SEO and Google Business Profile.

• AEO and AI Search optimization.

• Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog or similar SEO tools.

• GA4 and Google Search Console.

• WordPress or Shopify.

• YouTube SEO and thumbnail optimization.

• Google Ads and Meta Ads.

• Looker Studio or automated reporting.

• AI video generation and AI-assisted creative workflows.

• MCP, custom AI tools, skills or multi-step AI workflows.

• Basic knowledge of JSON, APIs or scripting.



Communication and working style

Strong spoken and written English is essential.



You should be someone who:

• Communicates clearly and professionally.

• Takes ownership instead of waiting for detailed instructions.

• Thinks about the wider objective behind a task.

• Identifies opportunities for improvement and automation.

• Raises questions or potential problems early.

• Provides transparent progress updates.

• Works independently while staying closely connected to the team.

• Is reliable, organised and able to manage several projects at the same time.

• Is open to feedback and interested in continuously learning.

We especially value people who regularly ask:

Can this be done better, faster or more intelligently with AI?

Commitment



This is a full-time, long-term position.

Our team operates mainly during European working hours, so reliable overlap with CET/CEST is required.

The starting compensation is approximately USD 500 per month, depending on experience, skills and overall fit.

There is room for responsibilities and compensation to grow over time for someone who proves reliable and becomes an important part of the team.



Write “AI FIRST” at the beginning of your application so we know you have read the full job description.



How to apply

Please include:

• Your location, time zone and availability.

• At least two or three examples of videos you personally edited.

• A short explanation of your personal contribution to the work you provide.



We are especially interested in understanding how you think, how you use AI, how you improve performance and how reliably you execute, not only which tools you have used.

title: Appointment Setter / Sales Closer — High-Ticket B2B Offer
description:
About us



The Studio Formula is a done-for-you client acquisition service for boutique Pilates and fitness studio owners in the UK, US, Canada and Australia. We build and run their paid ads, landing pages and follow-up automation so their classes fill.



We're not a coaching company and we don't sell a course. The founder owns and operates a Pilates studio running 91% class occupancy and 57% profit margins — and has never taught a class in it. That studio is where the system was built, and it's the proof the offer rests on.



The offer is $3,000 setup + $1,997/month on a 90-day program, backed by a written guarantee: we agree a member target with the client on the call, and if we miss it we refund the setup fee and keep working free until we hit it.



What you'll do



You own everything from booked application to closed client:



- Work inbound applications from paid ads — no cold calling, no DM prospecting, no list building

- Confirm and re-confirm booked calls so people actually show up (this is half the job)

- Chase no-shows and rebook them

- Run the 45-minute Strategy Call: work through the prospect's real numbers (classes per week, occupancy, member value), calculate what their empty class spots cost them monthly, and close the ones who fit

- Disqualify the ones who don't. Studios under $20,000/month get turned away — we'd rather lose the sale than take money from someone it won't work for

- Keep GoHighLevel clean: notes, pipeline stages, follow-up tasks



Hours



Calls run in United States timezone:

- US East Coast: late evening / overnight PHT

You need to be genuinely available in the US block. That's where the leads currently are.



Full-time paid position available after 3 months of proven results. We run other offers, and a setter/closer who proves out on this one moves into a salaried role across the portfolio. That's the actual path here — this is a proving ground, not a permanent commission arrangement.



What we're honest about



We'd rather tell you now than have you quit in week two:



This offer is early. We are building the sales process, not handing you a finished one. There is no proven script yet. You'll be building it with the founder from real call recordings.

Lead volume is currently low — single-digit applications per week while we scale ad spend. If you need 20 calls a week to make your numbers, this isn't your role yet.

Show rate is currently poor (~25%). Fixing that is the single biggest thing you can do here and the fastest way to earn.

If you want guaranteed income from day one, apply somewhere else. If you want a percentage of a high-ticket offer you helped build, and a full-time seat if it works, read on.

Requirements

2+ years closing or setting for info products, coaching, consulting, agency or other high-ticket B2B offers. This is non-negotiable — we will ask for specifics and check them.

Comfortable holding a 45-minute consultative call with a business owner who has real money at stake

Excellent spoken English, neutral or Western accent. You'll be speaking with UK, US and Australian business owners about a $5,000+ commitment. They need to feel they're talking to a peer.

Confident with numbers — you'll be doing live arithmetic on a prospect's occupancy and member value on the call

GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred (or comparable CRM — HubSpot, Close, Pipedrive)

Quiet room, headset, stable internet, Zoom

Thick skin about disqualifying people. We turn most applicants down and you have to be able to do that without flinching.

This is NOT for you if

You've never closed a deal over $1,000

You need a base salary to cover your bills right now

You want a script handed to you on day one

You're uncomfortable telling a prospect they're not a fit

How to apply



Send the following. Applications missing any item are deleted unread.



A 2-minute video or voice recording answering: "A Pilates studio owner doing $25,000/month tells you 'I need to think about it, $3,000 upfront is a lot right now.' What do you say?" — unscripted, one take, don't over-produce it

Your last 3 months of numbers: calls taken, close rate, average deal size, offer you were selling

Two sentences on why a commission-only role makes sense for you right now

Subject line: STUDIO — [your close rate] — [highest ticket you've closed]



Example subject line: STUDIO — 22% — $8,000



We reply to everyone who follows the format. We reply to nobody who doesn't.

Pay

We are not looking for someone for one month. My longest editor has been with me for four months and has never had a single complaint about pay, hours, or how they're treated. That's how I run things and it isn't changing.



There is real room to grow here. As we add brands and accounts, the people already on the team get more work and more money before anyone new gets hired. Roles above editing will open up too, and those go to people who are already here.



Who I'm looking for



Hungry. You want to get better, not just get paid.

Consistent. You hit deadlines every day, not most days.
