title: Senior Executive Office Manager & Transaction Coordinator
description:
We are looking for an experienced real estate professional to become the operational right-hand to one of the top-producing eXp Realty agents in Washington State.



The business serves the Greater Seattle and Eastside markets, including Kirkland and Bellevue, and regularly works with sophisticated clients and luxury properties in the approximately $2 million to $5 million range.



This is not a traditional Transaction Coordinator position.



If your experience is primarily receiving a contract, entering deadlines, and taking the file through closing, this role will likely be too broad.



We need someone operating at a much higher level.



You will be responsible for helping manage the entire administrative side of a high-touch real estate business, including transactions, listings, executive support, office operations, client communication, systems, special projects, and marketing coordination.



The number of transactions is not unusually high. The complexity comes from the level of service.



Listings and transactions involve frequent communication, changing timelines, customized follow-up, detailed client requests, vendor coordination, marketing revisions, administrative responsibilities, and numerous small details that must be handled correctly.



Our clients are often highly accomplished and extremely detail-oriented.
s, contracts, listing information, reports, marketing materials, and client communications must be polished and accurate.



We need someone who naturally thinks:



What is missing?

What needs to happen next?

Who am I waiting on?

What could become a problem?

How can I create a system so this does not get missed again?



Your Responsibilities Will Include

Managing residential transactions from contract through closing

Coordinating luxury listings from pre-listing preparation through launch and closing

Tracking contracts, contingencies, deadlines, escrow, title, inspections, financing, and closing requirements

Coordinating staging, photography, repairs, signage, vendors, MLS information, disclosures, and listing timelines

Monitoring
, Slack, CRM activity, calendars, and time-sensitive communications

Following up persistently on missing documents, approvals, decisions, signatures, and information

Providing polished communication to clients, agents, lenders, escrow, title, vendors, and other partners

Managing executive calendars, appointments, reminders, meetings, and follow-up

Booking travel, hotels, transportation, reservations, and itineraries

Coordinating client events, team events, appreciation activities, and special projects

Maintaining organized CRM, client, transaction, and listing records

Preparing seller updates, showing reports, listing activity reports, and client communications

Supporting listing marketing, newsletters,
 campaigns, presentations, social media, and Canva materials

Making routine revisions to existing marketing templates and materials

Proofreading everything carefully before it reaches a client or the public

Building SOPs, checklists, workflows, templates, and tracking systems

Identifying operational problems and creating better processes

Looking ahead rather than waiting for every assignment

Finding useful projects and business improvements during slower periods



Marketing is part of the role, but we are not hiring a dedicated graphic designer or full-time marketing manager. You should be comfortable coordinating marketing, updating established materials, making routine Canva revisions, proofreading content, and ensuring projects are completed accurately.



Who We Are Looking For



We strongly prefer candidates with at least 5 years of real estate experience who have already supported a successful agent, luxury agent, executive, or high-producing real estate team.



Luxury real estate experience is highly preferred.



Washington State real estate experience is also strongly preferred, although an exceptional candidate with significant experience in another U.S. market will still be considered.



You should be:



Extremely detail-oriented

Proactive and inquisitive

Highly organized

Calm under pressure

Comfortable managing changing priorities

Excellent at written and verbal communication

Confident communicating with sophisticated and high-net-worth clients

Experienced with transactions and listing coordination

Strong with office management and executive support

Experienced building SOPs, processes, systems, and checklists

Comfortable managing travel, events, vendors, calendars, and logistics

Comfortable receiving direct feedback and making corrections quickly

Willing to ask questions rather than make assumptions

Capable of taking ownership without needing constant supervision

Consistent about checking your work before anything is sent

Comfortable making calls and following up until outstanding items are resolved



Experience with platforms such as SkySlope, TransactionDesk, Lofty, Google Workspace, Slack, Canva, or similar real estate systems is highly valuable.



Real estate has busy seasons and slower seasons. During busy periods, we need someone who can increase their intensity without allowing quality to decline. During slower periods, we expect you to identify ways to improve systems, organization, processes, and the client experience.



We are hiring an operator, not simply a task executor.



A DISC assessment will be required during the hiring process. A strong Steadiness (S) profile is highly preferred because this position requires consistency, patience, composure, dependable follow-through, and the ability to maintain performance when pressure increases.



This is a full-time remote position during U.S. Pacific Time business hours. Candidates may not maintain another active job, freelance workload, or outside professional commitment. Responsibilities may not be outsourced or delegated.

title: Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant (Accounting Degree Required)
description:
Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant



Full-Time | Work From Home | Australian Accounting Experience Required



***About the Role



We are seeking a strong, commercially minded and highly organised Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant to take ownership of the internal finance function for a growing Australian group of businesses.

This is a hands-on, all-rounder accounting role. You will be responsible for the complete finance cycle — from day-to-day transactions and reconciliations through to month-end close, management reporting, budgeting, cash flow forecasting, job costing, profitability analysis and KPI reporting.



You will also take ownership of important group financial administration, including insurance, licences and other renewals, and provide confidential financial support to the Founder.



This is not a purely transactional bookkeeping role, nor is it a position for someone who only reviews work prepared by others.



We need someone who can personally get into the detail, make sure the numbers are right, analyse what they mean and give management clear financial visibility.



You will work closely with the Founder and management team and play an important role in improving profitability, cash flow, financial controls and decision-making across the Group.



**Key Responsibilities



1. Day-to-Day Accounting & Finance



Take ownership of the day-to-day internal accounting function across multiple entities, including:

•	Bank and credit card reconciliations

•	Accounts payable and accounts receivable oversight

•	Payroll and payroll-related reconciliations

•	Intercompany transactions and reconciliations

•	Balance sheet reconciliations

•	Fixed asset and accounting schedules

•	Correct transaction coding and supporting documentation

•	Investigation and correction of accounting discrepancies

•	Maintenance of accurate and up-to-date financial records

•	Identification of unusual transactions, errors and control weaknesses



You will be expected to remain hands-on and capable of completing detailed accounting work yourself when required.



2. Month-End Closing & Management Accounts



Take full ownership of the month-end process, including:

•	Month-end journals

•	Accruals and prepayments

•	Payroll reconciliations

•	Balance sheet reconciliations

•	Intercompany reconciliations

•	Revenue and expense cut-off

•	Review of P&L and balance sheet

•	Investigation of unusual movements

•	Preparation of management accounts

•	Month-end management commentary

•	Ensuring reporting is completed accurately and on time



The successful candidate should be capable of independently driving month-end close without needing to be reminded of each task.



3. Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow

•	Prepare and maintain annual budgets

•	Maintain rolling forecasts

•	Prepare and maintain a rolling cash flow forecast

•	Monitor actual results against budget

•	Analyse and explain material variances

•	Identify upcoming cash requirements and potential cash flow risks

•	Monitor working capital

•	Provide management with early warning of potential financial issues

•	Recommend practical actions based on financial results



4. Job Costing & Profitability Analysis



A major responsibility of this role is to establish strong visibility over profitability across the Group.

This includes:

•	Gross profit by client

•	Gross profit by employee

•	Gross profit by team/division

•	Gross profit by business entity

•	Client revenue versus labour cost

•	Actual hours/cost versus client budget

•	Employee utilisation and productivity

•	Revenue and cost per employee

•	Identification of underperforming clients, jobs or service areas

•	Identification of scope creep and cost overruns

•	Development and continuous improvement of job costing methodologies

•	Recommendations to improve margins and operational efficiency



The successful candidate must be able to go beyond producing numbers and explain what the numbers mean, why performance has changed and what management should investigate or change.



5. KPI Dashboard & Performance Reporting



Take ownership of the financial KPI and management reporting framework across the Group.



Responsibilities include:

•	Develop and maintain management KPI dashboards

•	Ensure KPI data is accurate, reconciled and supported by reliable source data

•	Monitor revenue, gross profit and GP%

•	Monitor profitability by client, employee, team and business entity

•	Monitor client budget versus actual hours/cost

•	Monitor employee utilisation and productivity

•	Track budget versus actual performance

•	Monitor cash flow and working capital

•	Monitor accounts receivable and overdue debts

•	Maintain historical KPI trends

•	Identify adverse trends and exceptions requiring management attention

•	Investigate the underlying causes of financial underperformance

•	Provide concise management commentary and recommendations

•	Continuously improve and automate KPI reporting where practical



The objective is to give management timely, accurate and actionable visibility over the financial health and performance of the Group.



This position is expected to highlight problems proactively rather than simply produce reports.



6. Group Finance & Corporate Administration



Take ownership of important recurring financial and administrative obligations, including:

•	Insurance renewals

•	Professional and business licence renewals

•	Registrations and other recurring compliance renewals

•	Finance and loan documentation

•	Subscription and contract renewals

•	Maintaining a centralised renewal and compliance calendar

•	Ensuring deadlines are identified well in advance

•	Obtaining information and quotations where required

•	Maintaining appropriate supporting documentation

•	Escalating matters requiring management approval



An important expectation of this position is that key financial and administrative obligations are proactively managed without relying on the Founder to remember or continually follow them up.



7. Founder / Personal Finance Support



Provide highly confidential financial and administrative support to the Founder, including:

•	Personal cash flow and financial reporting

•	Investment and property-related accounting records

•	Loan and finance schedules

•	Personal financial administration

•	Coordination of information required for tax and financial planning

•	Maintaining accurate records across personal and business financial matters



A very high level of confidentiality, integrity and discretion is essential.



8. Systems, Automation & Continuous Improvement

•	Improve finance processes, controls and reporting systems

•	Reduce unnecessary manual work

•	Identify opportunities for automation

•	Use technology and AI appropriately to improve finance efficiency

•	Ensure automated reports and processes remain accurate and properly controlled

•	Document important finance processes

•	Build scalable finance systems capable of supporting continued Group growth



**What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is an experienced all-rounder accountant who can work confidently from detailed transactions through to management-level financial analysis.



You should have:

•	Degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent

•	CPA/CA qualification or progress towards qualification highly regarded

•	Strong Australian accounting experience

•	Strong management accounting experience

•	Demonstrated experience independently completing month-end close

•	Budgeting and cash flow forecasting experience

•	Strong job costing and profitability analysis skills

•	Advanced Excel skills

•	Strong Xero experience

•	Excellent reconciliation and problem-solving skills

•	Experience working across multiple entities

•	Strong attention to detail

•	Strong written and verbal communication skills

•	Excellent organisational and deadline-management skills

•	High level of confidentiality and professional judgement

•	Ability to work independently with limited supervision



**The Person We Want



We are looking for someone who:

•	Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions

•	Is naturally organised and follows matters through to completion

•	Notices when numbers do not make sense and investigates why

•	Can move comfortably between detailed accounting and commercial analysis

•	Is willing to remain hands-on

•	Can prioritise effectively in a fast-moving environment

•	Builds systems and controls rather than repeatedly fixing the same problems

•	Is proactive about upcoming deadlines and financial risks

•	Communicates issues early rather than waiting until they become urgent

•	Can respectfully challenge numbers, assumptions and processes

•	Looks continuously for opportunities to automate and improve finance processes

•	Understands that good internal finance is not simply about producing accounts — it is about giving management visibility, control and actionable information



**Key Measures of Success



Success in this position will include:

•	Accurate and timely month-end closing

•	Reliable management accounts

•	Fully reconciled balance sheet accounts

•	Reliable budget versus actual reporting

•	Accurate and regularly maintained cash flow forecasting

•	Clear visibility of gross profit by client, employee, team and business area

•	Reliable KPI dashboards

•	Early identification and escalation of financial risks

•	Strong accounts receivable and working capital visibility

•	No missed insurance, licence or important renewal deadlines

•	Improved finance processes, controls and automation

•	Reduced reliance on the Founder for routine finance administration and follow-up



**The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of the internal finance function of a growing Australian business group.

For the right person, the position has significant potential to develop into a broader finance leadership role as the Group continues to grow.

title: EXPERIENCED XACTIMATE RESTORATION ESTIMATOR - $2500 month
description:
# EXPERIENCED XACTIMATE RESTORATION ESTIMATOR



## Full-Time Remote | Phoenix, Arizona Hours



**PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING.**



There are specific application instructions throughout this post.



**If you do not follow ALL application instructions, you will not be considered for the position.**



We are looking for someone who pays attention to details, follows directions, and takes their career seriously. Consider the application process your first opportunity to show us how you work.



---



# THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION



**Xactimate experience is REQUIRED.**



You must already be proficient at reviewing restoration documentation and building detailed, accurate Xactimate estimates and invoices.



If you have never written Xactimate estimates yourself, please do not apply.



If you only have basic Xactimate exposure, please do not apply.



If you need someone to teach you how to write restoration estimates from the beginning, this is not the right position.



We are specifically looking for an **experienced estimator who can contribute quickly and continue becoming an expert in the field.**



**Symbility experience is a major bonus.**



---



# ABOUT ZONA RESTORATION



Zona Restoration is an established restoration company based in the Phoenix, Arizona market.



We handle property damage projects involving:



* Water damage

* Fire and smoke damage

* Mold remediation

* Asbestos abatement

* Reconstruction

* Roofing

* Insurance claims



We have been in business since 2012 and have built our company around doing quality work, taking care of customers, and continually improving how we operate.



We are looking for someone who wants more than a temporary freelance job.



**We want someone who wants to become part of our team, grow with the company, improve their skills, take on more responsibility, and increase their growth and income as their value to the company increases.**



---



# YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



You will work with our restoration team to turn our field documentation into accurate, detailed, defensible estimates and invoices.



Our field team will provide documentation including:



* Photos

* Videos

* Measurements

* Moisture documentation

* Technician notes

* Equipment information

* Scope notes

* Insurance information

* Other supporting documents



You will review that information and build professional estimates and invoices.



You should understand restoration well enough to recognize when documentation supports additional legitimate line items that may have been missed.



We do not want someone who simply enters whatever information is handed to them.



**We want an estimator who understands the work, thinks critically, catches missing items, asks good questions, and produces a complete and defensible scope.**



---



# TYPES OF ESTIMATES YOU MAY WRITE



You should be comfortable working with several types of property damage claims, including:



### Mitigation



* Water mitigation

* Emergency services

* Demolition

* Cleaning

* Contents manipulation

* Mold remediation

* Asbestos abatement



### Reconstruction



* Drywall

* Paint

* Flooring

* Cabinets

* Countertops

* Trim

* Doors

* Framing

* Insulation

* Electrical

* Plumbing

* General reconstruction

* Larger loss reconstruction



### Fire



* Fire damage

* Smoke damage

* Cleaning

* Contents

* Demolition

* Reconstruction

* Large-loss estimating



### Roofing



You may occasionally assist with:



* Roof repairs

* Roof replacements

* Storm damage

* Insurance roofing claims

* Supplements



Roofing experience is preferred but is not required if your restoration estimating experience is strong.



---



# ADJUSTER COMMUNICATION & CLAIM NEGOTIATION



This position is not limited to writing estimates.



You must also be comfortable communicating professionally with insurance adjusters and other claim representatives.



Responsibilities may include:



* Reviewing carrier estimates

* Comparing carrier scopes against our scope

* Identifying missing or incorrect line items

* Preparing supplements

* Providing supporting documentation

* Responding to estimate revisions

* Discussing legitimate scope differences

* Explaining why specific work or line items are necessary

* Following up on outstanding approvals

* Negotiating scope and pricing disagreements

* Moving claims toward resolution and approval



Our goal is not to add unnecessary items to claims.



Our goal is to make sure the estimate accurately reflects the work that was legitimately required or needs to be completed and that our documentation supports our scope.



You must be comfortable professionally defending your estimate.



---



# THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who:



* Is punctual - If you aren't consistent and cant show up for your shift lets not waste each others time

* Has significant hands-on Xactimate estimating experience

* Can write estimates independently

* Understands restoration terminology and processes

* Understands insurance restoration claims

* Understands mitigation and reconstruction scopes

* Knows how to identify commonly missed legitimate line items

* Understands supporting documentation

* Can review and challenge carrier estimates

* Is comfortable communicating with adjusters

* Writes professional
s

* Communicates clearly with our internal team

* Pays extremely close attention to detail

* Takes ownership of their work

* Meets deadlines

* Does not need constant supervision

* Can manage multiple estimates at the same time

* Asks questions when documentation is incomplete

* Wants to continually improve



We especially want someone who takes pride in becoming **exceptionally good at their craft.**



If you enjoy learning Xactimate, understanding restoration, finding legitimate missing scope items, and building extremely thorough estimates, you're likely an EXCELLENT fit.



---



# REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You must have:



* Professional Xactimate experience

* Experience personally writing Xactimate estimates

* Strong knowledge of Xactimate line items

* Restoration and/or insurance estimating experience

* Strong written English & spoken English

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to work independently

* Reliable computer

* Reliable high-speed internet



Preferred experience:



* Symbility

* Water mitigation

* Asbestos

---

# HOW TO APPLY

## 1.
/APPLICATION SUBJECT

**ESTIMATOR HIRING MANAGER**

title: E-Commerce Creative Strategist
description:
About Us



We are a fast-growing seven-figure e-commerce team operating in the beauty niche. Our focus is building high-performing direct-response creative that drives profitable growth across paid social channels.



We are not looking for someone who simply copies competitors or scrolls Meta Ad Library for ideas. We are looking for a creative strategist who understands how to study winning brands, decode why their ads work, and turn those insights into original concepts that fit our brand, audience, and offer.



The right person understands hooks, angles, awareness levels, customer psychology, problem-aware and solution-aware messaging, and how to turn research into ads that sell.



Role Overview



As our E-Commerce Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for researching competitors, analyzing high-performing 8- and 9-figure e-commerce brands across multiple niches, developing original ad angles, and working with our creative team to produce winning ads.



You will study what is working in the market, identify patterns, and translate those patterns into fresh creative ideas for our beauty brand. This role requires a strong understanding of direct-response marketing, paid social advertising, consumer psychology, and e-commerce creative strategy.



You should be equally comfortable analyzing ads, writing hooks, building creative briefs, studying customer pain points, and developing new concepts that help us scale.



Responsibilities

Creative Research & Market Analysis



Research competitors in the beauty niche and identify winning ad formats, hooks, offers, angles, and messaging patterns.



Study 8- and 9-figure e-commerce brands across other niches such as skincare, supplements, fashion, wellness, home goods, personal care, and consumer products.



Analyze Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, landing pages, advertorials,
 funnels, product pages, UGC ads, founder-led ads, testimonial ads, and other creative assets.



Break down why certain ads are working instead of simply collecting examples.



Identify trends in customer psychology, creative formats, hooks, objections, mechanisms, and offers.



Build and maintain a swipe file of winning creative examples, organized by angle, awareness level, hook type, format, and niche.



Ad Concept Development



Develop original ad concepts based on research, customer insights, and brand positioning.



Write strong hooks, headlines, opening lines, scripts, and creative angles for paid social ads.



Create concepts for UGC ads, founder-style ads, problem-solution ads, testimonial ads, comparison ads, listicle-style ads, education ads, and direct-response product demos.



Understand and apply different customer awareness levels, including unaware, problem-aware, solution-aware, product-aware, and most-aware audiences.



Create messaging that speaks to customer pain points, desires, objections, buying triggers, and emotional motivations.



Translate research into clear creative briefs for video editors, designers, UGC creators, and media buyers.



Strategy & Testing



Work with the media buying and creative teams to develop structured testing plans.



Identify new angles to test based on performance data, market research, and customer feedback.



Analyze ad performance to understand which hooks, angles, formats, and messages are resonating.



Help refine creative based on metrics such as thumbstop rate, hold rate, CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS, and other paid media performance indicators.



Develop creative iterations based on winning concepts without making the ads feel repetitive or copied.



Customer & Brand Understanding



Deeply understand our beauty customer, their problems, desires, insecurities, routines, objections, and buying behavior.



Study customer reviews, comments, competitor reviews, Reddit threads, TikTok comments, Amazon reviews, and other voice-of-customer sources.



Turn customer language into high-converting ad messaging.



Ensure creative stays aligned with the brand’s tone, positioning, and product benefits.



Avoid generic, overused, or “template-like” ads by developing concepts that feel native, fresh, and specific to our customer.



Requirements



2+ years of experience in e-commerce creative strategy, direct-response copywriting, performance marketing, or paid social advertising.



Strong understanding of Meta ads, TikTok ads, UGC content, and short-form direct-response creative.



Proven ability to research competitors and other successful e-commerce brands to identify useful patterns.



Strong copywriting skills, especially for hooks, ad scripts, headlines, and short-form direct-response messaging.



Understanding of customer awareness levels, including problem-aware, solution-aware, product-aware, and most-aware messaging.



Ability to analyze why ads work from a psychology, positioning, and creative structure perspective.



Experience creating creative briefs for designers, video editors, or UGC creators.



Strong taste in creative and ability to distinguish between generic ads and truly compelling concepts.



Comfortable working with performance data and using it to guide creative decisions.



Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple creative ideas and tests at once.



Nice to Have



Experience working with beauty, skincare, cosmetics, personal care, wellness, or women-focused e-commerce brands.



Experience with 7-, 8-, or 9-figure DTC brands.



Experience using tools like Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Foreplay, Motion, MagicBrief, Minea, AdSpy, Notion, Google Sheets, or similar research/creative tools.



Understanding of landing pages, advertorials, funnels, CRO, and offer strategy.



Experience writing scripts for UGC creators or influencer-style ads.



What We Are Not Looking For



Someone who only copies competitor ads.



Someone who relies on generic hooks and recycled templates.



Someone who only collects ads but cannot explain why they work.



Someone who does not understand customer psychology.



Someone who needs to be told every angle to test.



Someone who cannot turn research into original creative ideas.



What Success Looks Like



You consistently bring fresh, well-researched ad concepts to the team.



Your creative briefs are clear, strategic, and easy for creators/editors to execute.



You understand what is working across the e-commerce landscape and can adapt those insights to our beauty brand.



Your hooks, angles, and scripts help improve ad performance.



You help us build a repeatable creative research and testing system.



You contribute original ideas instead of simply copying what competitors are doing.



Example Tasks



Research 10 winning beauty ads and break down the hook, angle, offer, awareness level, emotional trigger, and creative format.



Study 5 successful 8- or 9-figure e-commerce brands outside of beauty and identify creative patterns we can adapt.



Write 20 new hooks for a problem-aware audience.



Create 5 new UGC ad concepts based on customer reviews.



Turn a winning competitor angle into an original concept that fits our brand.



Analyze recent ad performance and suggest new creative iterations based on the data.



Who You Are



You are curious, strategic, and obsessed with understanding why people buy.



You enjoy studying winning brands, ads, funnels, and customer behavior.



You know that great creative is not random. It comes from research, psychology, pattern recognition, and smart execution.



You can look at an ad and explain the hook, the angle, the awareness level, the core promise, the objection being handled, and why it may be converting.



Most importantly, you know how to take inspiration from the market without copying it.

title: Amazon/Walmart VA – Full Account Management
description:
We're looking for a detail-oriented, proactive Virtual Assistant to fully manage our day-to-day Seller Central operations — from daily account maintenance and customer service to PPC advertising, product image creation, listing optimization, and everything in between. This is a full-scope role for someone who can own the account end to end with minimal supervision.



What You'll Do



PPC & Advertising



Create, launch, and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns on Amazon

Manage Walmart Connect (Sponsored Products) campaigns

Conduct daily/weekly bid adjustments, budget management, and search term (negative keyword) mining

Run keyword research for new campaign targets and expansion opportunities

Basic photo editing/retouching (background removal, resizing, compression for upload requirements)



Daily Account Maintenance

Respond to buyer/customer messages within required response-time windows

Track and manage orders, shipments, returns, and refunds

Monitor inventory levels and flag low-stock/restock needs

Check and resolve listing errors, suppressed listings, and pricing/Buy Box issues

Track account health metrics (ODR, late shipment rate, valid tracking rate, etc.) and escalate issues promptly

Respond to and manage product reviews/feedback where applicable

Maintain a daily/weekly task log or checklist for the team



Listing Optimization & Keyword Research



Conduct keyword research using tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar

Write and optimize listing titles, bullet points, descriptions, and backend search terms for both Amazon and Walmart

Monitor listing health, suppress/error flags, and buy box status

Perform competitor research and identify optimization opportunities

Assist with keyword indexing checks and rank tracking



Catalog & Listing Management



Create new product listings on Amazon and Walmart (single and variation/parent-child listings)

Prepare and upload flat files/bulk feeds; troubleshoot upload errors

Request and manage category/gating approvals

Set up and maintain UPC/GTIN, brand registry, and catalog data accuracy

Update pricing, titles, and content as needed for seasonal or promotional changes



Customer Service & Case Management



Respond to customer inquiries and messages within platform SLAs

Open and manage Seller Support cases with Amazon and Walmart for account, listing, or order issues

Handle A-to-Z Guarantee claims, chargebacks, and buyer disputes

Process and track returns, replacements, and refunds

Respond professionally to negative feedback and product reviews, and request removal of policy-violating reviews when applicable



Inventory & Supply Chain Support



Monitor inventory levels across FBA/FBM and Walmart fulfillment; flag restock needs before stockouts

Create and track FBA shipment plans, and monitor shipment/receiving status

Monitor storage fees, aged inventory, and excess/long-term storage alerts

Coordinate with suppliers or the team on purchase order timing based on sales velocity



Promotions & Account Growth



Set up and manage Lightning Deals, Coupons, Prime Exclusive Discounts, and Walmart promotions/rollbacks

Support external traffic/deal-site coordination as directed

Monitor and manage the brand Storefront and Walmart brand shelf content



Reporting & Analytics



Prepare regular (daily/weekly/monthly) sales, PPC, and account health reports

Track key KPIs: sales, sessions, conversion rate, ACOS/TACOS, inventory health, and account health metrics

Flag trends, risks, or opportunities to the team proactively



Account Health & Compliance



Monitor account health dashboards daily (Amazon Account Health, Walmart Seller Scorecard) and address issues before they escalate

Respond to policy violation notices, IP complaints, and listing suppressions

Assist with reinstatement/appeal documentation if an account or listing is suspended

Stay current on Amazon and Walmart policy changes that affect the account

What We're Looking For

5+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central and/or Walmart Seller Center accounts end-to-end (please share account examples/portfolio)

Hands-on experience running Amazon PPC campaigns (Sponsored Products required; Sponsored Brands/Display a plus) and familiarity with Walmart Connect

Experience with day-to-day account operations: order management, customer service, case handling, and account health monitoring

Proficiency in Canva, Photoshop, or similar design tools for product image/infographic creation

Working knowledge of keyword research tools (Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Data Dive, or similar)

Experience creating and managing product listings, including variations and flat file uploads

Strong written English for customer communication and listing copywriting

Highly organized and able to independently manage multiple SKUs, cases, and tasks without heavy oversight

Reliable internet connection and own equipment

Comfortable with Google Sheets/Excel for reporting and task tracking



Nice to Have



Experience with Amazon Brand Registry, A+ Content, and Storefront design

Experience managing FBA shipment plans and inventory forecasting

Experience handling A-to-Z claims, suspensions, or reinstatement appeals

Experience with PPC automation/management tools like Helium 10 Adtomic or Perpetua

How to Apply



Please send:



Your updated resume/CV

A short portfolio or examples of product images/A+ Content you've created

Examples of PPC campaigns you've managed (screenshots or case study, with results if possible — sales figures may be redacted)

A brief summary of your experience with account maintenance, customer service, and case management

Your available hours and expected hourly rate



Subject line: "Amazon/Walmart VA – Full Account Management – [Your Name]"



We review applications on a rolling basis and will follow up with qualified candidates for a short paid trial task.

title: Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist
description:
Who We Are:



At Escend Media, we help D2C brands implement retention strategies that increase profit and drive customer retention. We want to be the ‘who’ behind
s that people ask ‘dannngg, who designed that’.



What We Do:

We help 7 and 8 figure ecommerce businesses develop, optimize and scale their owned media marketing efforts. Whether they are just looking to start
 marketing, they need to really refine what they are currently doing or they need someone to take
 marketing off their shoulders, we’re here to help them so that they can focus on running the business.



Our clients are leaders in their industry and have built strong relationships with the customers they serve. Our job is to ensure that their brand image stays consistent online and offline and, more importantly, that their business is growing.





Summary of The Position:



The Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist is responsible for the strategic implementation and optimization of post-purchase upsell funnels, primarily utilizing platforms like Aftersell. This role focuses on enhancing Average Order Value (AOV) and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) for Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce brands by creating highly relevant and effective post-purchase offers. The specialist will manage the full lifecycle of implementation, from strategic planning and A/B testing to performance monitoring and continuous optimization, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with brand objectives.



Responsibilities:



• Implement and manage post-purchase upsell funnels using platforms such as Aftersell, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives to increase AOV and CLTV.

• Conduct systematic A/B testing across various elements including product selection, offer and pricing structures, pricing angles, copywriting, psychological angles, user interface (UI) optimization, and customer segmentation.

• Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Acceptance Rate, AOV Lift, Incremental Profit/Session, and Upsell Conversion Rate, optimizing for Revenue Per Visitor (RPV) and Profit Per Visitor (PPV).

• Ensure technical and creative requirements are met for all implementations, including fulfillment safety (e.g., 'Order on Hold' feature), mobile responsiveness, brand consistency, and effective inventory management.

• Collaborate with marketing and design teams to ensure brand consistency and compelling offer presentation.

• Identify and avoid common pitfalls such as the 'Wall of Text' error and the 'Irrelevance' trap, focusing on clear value propositions and relevant offers.

• Leverage customer data, loyalty programs, and other add-ons to enhance post-purchase strategies and maximize incremental revenue.

• Continuously refine and improve post-purchase strategies based on performance data and evolving market trends.



Our Culture:



• No one is bigger than the team

• We don’t make excuses, we take responsibility

• Innovate everywhere

• Communicate. Communicate. Communicate. We have a culture of open communication.



Required Skills:



• Proven experience in implementing and optimizing post-purchase upsell strategies, preferably with platforms like Aftersell.

• Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics and their impact on business growth (AOV, CLTV, ROAS, RPV, PPV).

• Demonstrated expertise in A/B testing methodologies and data-driven optimization.

• Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to quality assurance in all implementations.

• Knowledge of mobile UI/UX best practices for e-commerce.

• Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.

• Experience with project management software (e.g., Clickup) is a plus.

• Proactive approach with a sense of urgency and purpose in daily tasks.



Perks:

- Flexible working hours

- Remote working

- Room to grow - we're an early stage start up with a proven track record

- Competitive compensation

- Work with some amazing brands



This Role Is Perfect for You If…



- You love working as a team.

- You are a self-starter.

- You can work under pressure

- You have exceptional communication skills

- You are results/outcome driven.

- You have a ‘can-do’ attitude. If “that’s not my job” isn’t in your vocabulary, you’ll fit in great!



This Role is NOT the Right Fit For You If You Are…

- A ‘me first’ type of person

- Not a self-starter.

- Not a ‘people person’

- Problem driven, not solution oriented. If you complain about problems/issues/bottlenecks, without proposing a solution, this is not for you.

- Looking for a typical 9-5. If you hate Mondays, this is not for you. We’re a mission-driven company who are all about changing the lives and businesses that we work with. If we have something that needs to get done, we’ll have all hands on deck. Sometimes you might have to work late but sometimes you’ll get the afternoon off, it’s not all work no play, but we’re here to help business grow!

WHAT YOU WILL DO



Respond to enterprise customer questions across shared Slack channels and
, with speed and accuracy as the standard.

Excellent organization and follow through. Nothing falls through the cracks.



Availability to begin the workday at 8:00 or 9:00 AM Mountain Time.

Experience working on Amazon, whether as an Amazon or marketplace specialist at a brand, at an agency, or as a seller.

Familiarity with tools such as Slack, HubSpot, or Notion.

Enterprise customers judge a platform by how it feels when something goes wrong. You are the person who makes that moment go well. Done right, this role is one of the biggest drivers of retention in the business.

Location: Fully remote

Team: Enterprise Account Management

title: VETERAN Expired Listing Cold Caller / Appointment Setter - US Real Estate (Hiring 1-2)
description:
ABOUT US

McCaw Property Management is a residential property management and brokerage company in the Fort Worth / North Texas area. We are launching an outbound calling program targeting owners of expired and withdrawn MLS listings in our market, and we're hiring 1-2 veteran callers to run it.



THE ROLE

You will call owners whose homes did not sell and steer qualified conversations to one of three outcomes: (1) lease the home with our professional property management, (2) relist it for sale with us, or (3) a direct purchase offer on select properties. You qualify the owner and set phone appointments for two people on our team, Daniel and Pam, who take those meetings. You confirm every appointment and log everything in Follow Up Boss.



READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING

This is NOT a role we will train from scratch. We want people who have already run successful expired-listing campaigns for real estate agents, investors, or property managers - and who arrive knowing how the machine works when it works: the data, the dialer, the script, the confirmation cadence that gets owners to actually show up. You will help us stand this program up, not just dial. If you have never called expired listings specifically, please do not apply.



REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years US real estate cold calling, with at least 1 year calling EXPIRED/WITHDRAWN listings specifically

- Hands-on experience with expired-lead platforms (Vulcan7, REDX, Mojo, or similar) - you know how the data and dialers work

- Follow Up Boss experience strongly preferred (it's our CRM)

- Real numbers you can speak to: dials/day, contact rate, appointments set and HELD per week

- Clear, confident spoken English; comfortable with US homeowners who have been called by 20 agents already

- Available Monday-Friday during US Central business hours

- Fast, reliable internet with power and internet backup

- Full-time preferred; strong part-time veterans considered



COMPENSATION

Competitive hourly rate (tell us your expectation) PLUS a per-held-appointment bonus. This starts as a paid 30-day trial with clear KPIs agreed up front. If the numbers are there, it becomes a long-term role - we want this machine running for years, and we'd rather keep proven people than restart.



HOW TO APPLY (follow exactly - applications missing any item will not be read)

1. Put the word TURNKEY as the first line of your application.

2. Voice sample (60-90 seconds, Vocaroo link is fine): a mock cold-call opener. Scenario: you're calling a Dallas-Fort Worth homeowner whose listing expired last week after 90 days on the market. Introduce McCaw Property Management, acknowledge the home didn't sell, pivot to renting it out with professional management as one of three options, and ask for the appointment. No polished script reading - we want to hear a live call.

3. Describe, briefly and specifically, the most successful expired-listing campaign you personally ran: who it was for, what data/dialer/CRM stack you used, your dials per day, contact rate, appointments set and held per week, and what made it work.

4. Tell us: your hourly rate expectation, the hours you can commit (US Central), your internet speed, and your backup setup.

5. If you were building our campaign from day one, what data source and dialer would you pick to pair with Follow Up Boss, and why?

title: Cold Caller- Commercial Real Estate (List Builder)

Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do

What You Bring

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Bonus Points For

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Prior appointment-setting experience for acquisitions or investment sales teams

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role

Performance-based incentives/bonuses — the better you perform, the more you earn

Real growth opportunities — this is a growing company, and top performers won't go unnoticed

A supportive, performance-driven team — we win together, and we celebrate wins

Send your updated resume and a short recording (Loom or Vocaroo — link only)

# Part-Time Tax Data Entry Virtual Assistant – TaxSlayer



## Job Overview



We are looking for a **reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant with tax preparation/data entry experience** to assist our tax office with entering client information into **TaxSlayer Pro**.



This is a **part-time position for 10 hours per week**, split between **2 working days per week at 5 hours per day**.



You must be available to work during the hours of:



**10:00 AM – 3:00 PM Eastern Time**



on your assigned working days.



This position is primarily focused on **accurate client data entry**, so attention to detail, confidentiality, speed, and accuracy are extremely important.



## Schedule



* Part-Time

* 10 hours per week

* 2 days per week

* 5 hours per day

* Working hours: **10:00 AM – 3:00 PM Eastern Time**

* Exact working days will be established upon hiring

* Additional hours may become available during peak tax season based on workload and performance



## Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be entering client tax information into TaxSlayer accurately and efficiently.



Tasks may include:



* Entering new clients into TaxSlayer

* Entering banking information

* Entering identification information from driver's licenses/state IDs

* Updating client records when additional documents are received

* Organizing client information according to our internal procedures

* Following our workflow and data-entry procedures

* Communicating when information is missing, unclear, or does not match

* Maintaining complete confidentiality of all taxpayer information



**You will NOT be responsible for making tax decisions or providing tax advice unless specifically trained and authorized to do so.**



## Preferred Experience



Previous experience working with **TaxSlayer Pro** is strongly preferred.



Experience with any of the following is also helpful:

Because you will have access to sensitive taxpayer information, **confidentiality and data security are mandatory. Client documents and information may not be downloaded, copied, photographed, shared, saved to personal devices, or used outside of authorized company systems.**



## What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:

* Organized

* Consistent

* Honest

* Dependable

* Comfortable with repetitive data-entry work

* Able to catch discrepancies

* Able to follow the same process every time

* Comfortable asking questions when necessary

* Interested in working with us throughout tax season



Accuracy is more important than simply entering information quickly.



## HOW TO APPLY



**Please do not send a generic application.**



In your application, answer **ALL** of the following questions:

title: Senior Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist
description:
OnePet is a portfolio of digitally native pet brands, including Total Vet, CertaPet, and Honest Paws. We help pet owners discover, decide, and purchase trustworthy products and services for their pets.



We're looking for a highly resourceful Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist to own link acquisition and off-site authority building across 3-4 primary domains.



This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role. We're looking for someone who can identify opportunities, decide how to attack them, and execute - not someone who needs a large team, detailed SOPs, or constant direction.



Buying links can be a tactic. It cannot be your entire strategy.



What You'll Do

Your job is straightforward: build a stronger, more diverse, and more valuable backlink and off-site brand profile that contributes to higher rankings and more organic traffic.

Creative link acquisition: Develop campaigns and angles that give publishers a real reason to link - original data, statistics, surveys, resources, visual assets, tools, awards, rankings, expert contributions, or ideas we haven't thought of yet.

Digital PR & media outreach: Find newsworthy angles, identify journalists and publishers, pitch stories and expertise, and turn those relationships into coverage, links, and brand mentions.

Traditional link building: Execute competitive link-gap analysis, reclamation, broken-link opportunities, unlinked mentions, resource outreach, guest contributions, partnerships, directories, and other proven tactics.

Paid placements: Identify worthwhile opportunities, evaluate quality and risk, negotiate pricing and terms, and determine whether the expected value justifies the cost.

GEO & brand visibility: Pursue relevant brand mentions, citations, and off-site signals that can improve visibility across ChatGPT, Google AI experiences, Perplexity, and other answer engines - not just traditional search.

Experimentation: Continuously test new approaches while maintaining reliable campaigns that produce consistent results.

Not every experiment needs to work. The overall program does.



How You'll Operate

You'll have substantial freedom to determine how you get results. We expect you to understand the backlink profiles of the sites you're responsible for, identify the biggest opportunities, communicate what you're pursuing, and then execute.

Use AI heavily. Automate where it makes sense. Build relationships. Negotiate. Develop assets. Run outreach. Find creative shortcuts. Use whatever legitimate resources and processes help you produce better results.

You will not be micromanaged. In return, you'll be accountable for outcomes.

If an opportunity carries meaningful SEO, reputational, or financial risk, we expect you to recognize it and discuss the risk/reward with us before proceeding. Otherwise, use good judgment and keep moving.



How We'll Measure Success

The primary scorecard starts with high-quality referring domains, links, brand mentions, and citations acquired.

Quality and relevance of referring domains

Number and diversity of links acquired

Brand mentions and AI/answer-engine citations

Growth and quality of our backlink profiles

Cost and value of paid acquisitions

Performance of different campaigns and tactics

The goal is improved rankings, search visibility, and organic traffic.

We'll have lightweight weekly and monthly reporting, and you'll maintain enough structured tracking for us to understand which sources, tactics, and campaigns are producing the best results.



What We're Looking For

We care more about what you've accomplished than how many years you've been doing it.

Acquire high-quality backlinks through multiple strategies - not just paid placements or mass outreach.

Evaluate whether a backlink opportunity is genuinely valuable using data and judgment.

Develop and execute creative link-building campaigns from idea through acquisition.

Conduct effective outreach to journalists, bloggers, publishers, website owners, and partners.

Evaluate and negotiate paid placements rather than simply accepting quoted prices.

Use competitive backlink analysis, reclamation, prospecting, and other core off-page SEO techniques.

Understand GEO/AEO and the growing importance of off-site brand mentions and citations.

Use AI to dramatically increase your research, prospecting, outreach, analysis, and execution capacity.

Run multiple campaigns independently and prioritize your time based on expected impact.

Communicate effectively in English internally and externally.

Know when to experiment, when to scale something that works, and when to stop wasting time on something that doesn't.

We don't care what industry you've worked in. We don't care whether you learned link building at an agency, in-house, independently, or somewhere else.

We care whether you can produce results.



Tools & Resources

Ahrefs

Google Search Console

SEO Gets

Claude company subscription

If another tool or resource will materially improve results, make the case for it.

The same applies to campaign and link-acquisition spend. We don't have a rigid price we're willing to pay for a link. Budget follows value. Find the opportunity, evaluate it intelligently, negotiate it well, and tell us why it's worth the investment.



The Role in One Sentence

Own off-page SEO across several domains, attack link acquisition from multiple angles, use AI and your own resourcefulness to execute at a high level, and be accountable for measurable results.

If that's already how you approach link building, we'd like to hear from you.

# Customer Service Representative — Shopify Dropshipping 
 Support)



We run multiple Shopify dropshipping stores in Europe and are looking for a reliable Customer Service Representative to join our customer support team.



This is an
 support role. You will handle customer
s, use our templates and workflows, log refunds in Google Sheets, and escalate complex cases when needed.



You MUST already have experience with customer service for dropshipping stores. Experience handling support for multiple stores at the same time is a big advantage.



---



## Main Responsibilities



* Answer customer
s for Shopify dropshipping stores

* Maintain a steady pace of around **20 answered
s per hour**

* Handle order questions, shipping updates, returns, refunds, lost packages, and defective product claims

* Use DeepL to translate Dutch, Polish, and other European customer
s

* Start from the correct pre-written template, but personalize every single reply — customers should never receive an obvious copy-paste answer

* Build and improve your own ChatGPT prompt/template so each
 is written specifically for that customer and their situation

* Handle refund requests using our step-by-step compensation ladder and keep the overall refund percentage as low as possible

* Keep customers calm and satisfied to reduce disputes and escalations

* Log refunds and important cases in Google Sheets

* Check supplier/order information when needed

* Escalate unclear, aggressive, or complex cases through Slack

* Coordinate with another CS team member so work is divided properly



---



## Refunds & Resolution Ladder



Refunds have a direct impact on our margins, so an important part of this role is solving problems properly instead of handing out money by default.



We work with a fixed ladder. You always start at the lowest step:



1. **20% partial refund** — the standard first offer

2. **40% partial refund** — only if the customer declines the first offer and the case justifies it

3. **60% partial refund** — final step, only for serious cases

4. **Return to our supplier in China** — the alternative if the customer does not accept a partial refund



Do not skip steps. Never jump to a higher percentage just because it is faster or easier, and never issue a full refund on your own — those cases go to Slack first.



Every offer must be explained in a friendly, personalized message so the customer feels heard and accepts the solution instead of opening a dispute or chargeback.



---



## Requirements



* Must have experience with CS for Shopify dropshipping stores

* Experience supporting multiple stores is preferred

* Excellent written English

* Strong attention to detail

* Able to follow workflows and templates exactly

* Confident handling refund negotiations and sticking to the compensation ladder

* Able to work at a fast, consistent pace (around 20
s per hour)

* Calm, professional tone with customers

* Comfortable using Gmail, Google Sheets, DeepL, Slack, and ChatGPT

* Comfortable running Hubstaff time tracking during your shifts

* Reliable internet and availability 6 days per week

* Able to work in a coordinated schedule with another CS team member



---



## Performance & Tracking



* We expect around **20
s answered per hour**. With templates, DeepL, and our documented workflows this is very achievable once you know the system.

* Working hours are tracked with **Hubstaff**, which records time and activity during your shift. Hubstaff only runs while you are clocked in on your shift.

* We also look at your **refund rate**: how many cases you manage to resolve at the lowest possible step of the ladder.

* Speed matters, but quality matters too. Wrong or careless replies create disputes, so accuracy comes first.



---



## Languages



You do not need to speak Dutch or other European languages.



We use DeepL, pre-written templates, and documented workflows. You need strong English and the ability to understand the customer issue correctly after translation.



---



## Hours & Compensation



* Part-time to start

* Around 12–18 hours per week

* **Around 2–3 hours per day, 6 days per week**

* More hours possible as workload grows

* **Rate: $4 per hour**

* Payment: weekly via Wise, based on the hours tracked in Hubstaff



The schedule is not fully random/flexible. You will work together with another CS team member, so hours need to be coordinated to avoid overlap and make sure
s are covered properly.



---



## Important



When you start your session, the assigned inbox must be cleared properly. Customer
s should not be left unanswered without a clear reason or escalation.



We are looking for someone reliable, consistent, and long-term.



---

9. Confirmation that you are comfortable with the $4/hour rate and the 20
s per hour target

Looking forward to working together long-term!

title: Low Voltage Support Engineer
description:
Technical Support — Security Systems

Two openings: Tier 1 Support  ·  Tier 2 / Tier 3 Support

About These Roles

We design, deploy, and support security and low voltage systems across commercial, residential, and municipal client sites — video surveillance, access control, intrusion, video monitoring, and the networks that carry all of it.

We are hiring two remote technical support roles. Both configure and troubleshoot live systems. The difference is depth: Tier 1 owns device and platform configuration to standard, and Tier 2/3 owns architecture, networking, escalated troubleshooting, and the technical calls that Tier 1 escalates.

Both roles are fully remote. Configuration, programming, onboarding, and troubleshooting are performed remotely in support of installation teams working on site. Occasional travel may be required for commissioning or complex turnover.

If you are strong on devices but light on networking, apply for Tier 1. 

If you can hold your own on subnetting, VLANs, point-to-point links, and system architecture, apply for Tier 2/3.

Systems and Platforms We Work With

You will not know all of these on day one. We list them so you know what the work actually involves and where your experience lines up.

Cameras and Video Surveillance

Hanwha, Axis, Digital Watchdog, Uniview, and comparable IP camera lines. Fixed, PTZ, multi-sensor, thermal, and LPR applications. Full configuration: addressing, streaming profiles, compression, exposure and image tuning, motion and analytics settings, time sync, firmware, and credential hardening.

Video Management Systems

DW Spectrum, Wisenet WAVE, and comparable VMS platforms. Camera onboarding, user and permission structures, recording schedules, retention and storage configuration, server health, licensing, and playback and export workflows.

Video Monitoring and Central Station

Immix and comparable central station monitoring platforms, plus camera-to-central bridges. Site and account setup, camera mapping, event and alarm rule configuration, arming schedules, video verification paths, and end-to-end signal path testing through to monitoring center presentation.

Video Analytics

AI and rules-based analytics platforms including server-based detection, cloud analytics, and camera-edge analytics. Detection zone and rule configuration, sensitivity tuning, false alarm reduction, and integration into the alarm pipeline.

Access Control

Brivo, PDK, and comparable cloud and on-premise access platforms. Electrified hardware including Dormakaba, ASSA ABLOY, and standard strike, maglock, and mortise applications. Door, reader, credential, schedule, group, and user configuration; controller and panel setup; and integration with video and intrusion.

Intrusion and Burglar Alarm

Ajax and comparable intrusion platforms. Panel programming, zone and partition configuration, device enrollment, user codes and arming schedules, communicator and signal path setup, and central station reporting verification.

Networking and Infrastructure

UniFi and comparable managed switching, routing, and wireless. Cellular routers and gateways, point-to-point and point-to-multipoint wireless links, VPN and remote access architecture, and PoE and power budgeting. Solar and battery-backed mobile surveillance units.

?How to apply — please read carefully



We are accepting applications by
. send resume  elipineda21  goog



with the subject line "System Support Tech — [Your Name]." A short note on your relevant experience is welcome.

Competency Expectations by Tier

This is what we expect you to own independently at each tier.

Area T1 — Support T2 / T3 — Support Required

Cameras & CCTV Configure cameras to standard: IP, credentials, streams, resolution, framerate, image settings, firmware. Own camera standards, storage and bandwidth sizing, multi-site design validation, and escalated image or stream faults.

Video Management (VMS) Add and configure cameras, users, recording schedules, and permissions in the VMS. Verify recording and playback. Server sizing, storage retention design, failover, licensing, VMS-to-platform integrations, and root-cause of recording loss.

Video Monitoring Onboard sites and cameras to the monitoring platform: accounts, camera mapping, event rules, arming schedules, video verification. Design monitoring account structures, tune analytics and rule logic to reduce false dispatch, and own platform integration architecture.

Analytics Enable and configure detection zones, rules, and sensitivity. Analytics tuning, model/zone strategy, and integration into the alarm pipeline.

Access Control Configure doors, readers, schedules, credentials, groups, and users. Verify door hardware operation and event reporting. System architecture, panel and controller configuration, integrations, lock and hardware troubleshooting, and vendor escalation.

Intrusion / Burg Configure zones, partitions, users, arming schedules, and communication paths. Verify signals reach central station. Panel programming, communicator and path design, integration with video and access, and escalated signal failures.

Networking Working knowledge: IP addressing, VLAN placement, PoE, switch ports, device reachability. Required: subnetting, VLAN and trunk design, routing, firewall and port forwarding, VPN, P2P and raw radio configuration, bandwidth planning.

Security Practices Change default credentials, apply firmware updates, follow the credential standard. Desired: network segmentation, least-privilege access, certificate and encryption handling, hardening standards, and remote access security.

Documentation Accurate device records, configuration notes, and clear issue write-ups. Define standards, review others' documentation, and produce root-cause and corrective-action records.



?

Tier 1 — Technical Support Specialist

What You'll Do

• Camera and device configuration. Configure IP cameras and edge devices to our standard — addressing, credentials, streaming profiles, resolution, framerate, bitrate, compression, image settings, motion and analytics, time sync, and firmware.

• CCTV and VMS programming. Add cameras to the VMS, build user and permission structures, set recording schedules and retention, and verify recording and playback.

• Video monitoring onboarding. Build sites and accounts in the monitoring platform, map cameras, configure event and alarm rules and arming schedules, and test that alarms present correctly to the monitoring center.

• Access control configuration. Configure doors, readers, credentials, schedules, groups, and users. Verify door hardware operates correctly and events report accurately.

• Intrusion configuration. Configure zones, partitions, users, arming schedules, and communication paths. Verify signals reach the central station.

• Remote field support. Support installation technicians over phone and video during install, configuration, testing, and turnover.

• Quality control. Verify installed devices and configurations match submittals, device schedules, and project records. Flag discrepancies.

• Documentation. Maintain accurate device records, configuration notes, and clear issue write-ups.

• Escalation. Escalate to Tier 2/3 with what you checked, what you ruled out, and what you think is happening.

Required

• Ability to configure IP cameras independently — addressing, streaming, credentials, and image settings — without step-by-step direction

• Working networking knowledge: IP addressing, VLAN placement, PoE, switch ports, and device reachability

• Methodical troubleshooting — the ability to isolate a fault to a layer rather than guess at it

• Ability to learn new software platforms quickly from documentation and vendor training

• Ability to read and work from drawings, device schedules, risers, and submittals

• Clear written documentation habits

• Ability to direct hands-on work over phone and video that you cannot perform yourself

• Reliable high-speed internet and a work space suitable for remote technical work

Preferred

• Hands-on experience with any of the platforms listed above

• Central station monitoring platform experience (Immix or comparable)

• CompTIA A+ or Network+, or equivalent coursework

• Prior experience in security integration, low voltage, IT support, or alarm industry technical support

Your First 90 Days

Days 1–30. Configure and commission cameras to standard across the manufacturers we use. Learn our naming conventions, device schedule format, and documentation standards.

Days 31–60. Independently onboard sites to the video monitoring platform and configure access control and intrusion systems on assigned projects.

Days 61–90. Own device configuration and platform onboarding for assigned projects end to end, escalating only what genuinely needs Tier 2/3.

?

Tier 2 / Tier 3 — Systems Support Engineer

This is the escalation point. When Tier 1 has exhausted what they can check, when a system is behaving in a way nobody can explain, or when a design decision needs to be made before install, this role owns it.

What You'll Do

• Escalated troubleshooting. Own faults that cross device, network, platform, and vendor boundaries. Drive them to a documented root cause rather than a workaround.

• Network architecture and configuration. Design and configure VLANs, subnets, routing, firewall rules, port forwarding, VPN tunnels, and remote access paths for security systems on customer and standalone networks.

• Point-to-point wireless. Design, align, and configure P2P and point-to-multipoint links at the radio level — raw configuration, channel and frequency planning, link budget, interference mitigation, and throughput validation.

• System design validation. Review designs, device schedules, risers, and submittals before install. Catch bandwidth, storage, power, and integration problems on paper instead of in the field.

• Integration architecture. Own integrations between video, access control, intrusion, analytics, and monitoring platforms — API, relay, and event-based.

• Security practices. Apply and enforce hardening standards: segmentation, least-privilege access, credential management, certificate and encryption handling, and secure remote access.

• Vendor escalation. Push vendor and manufacturer issues to resolution with specific findings, reproduction steps, and documented next steps.

• Technical direction. Serve as the escalation path and technical mentor for Tier 1. Review their findings and determine corrective action.

• Standards. Help build and improve configuration standards, documentation requirements, and quality control gates.

Required

• Strong hands-on experience across access control, CCTV, intrusion, and video monitoring systems

• Solid networking: subnetting, VLAN and trunk configuration, routing, DHCP and DNS, firewall rules and port forwarding, VPN, PoE budgeting, and bandwidth planning

• Point-to-point wireless experience at the configuration level — not just “we installed a link,” but aligning, tuning, and troubleshooting one

• Ability to troubleshoot across hardware, software, network, and vendor platform layers and isolate root cause

• Ability to read, review, and challenge drawings, submittals, risers, and device schedules

• Ability to work independently with minimal oversight and strong judgment on when to resolve versus escalate

• Strong documentation: issue logs, root-cause records, corrective actions, and risk summaries

• Ability to mentor and give clear technical direction to junior staff and field technicians remotely

• Reliable high-speed internet and a work space suitable for remote technical work

Desired

• Network security practices: segmentation strategy, least-privilege design, hardening standards, certificate handling, and secure remote access architecture

• CompTIA Network+ or Security+, CCNA, or equivalent certification

• Manufacturer certifications in access control, video, intrusion, or networking

• Experience with cellular gateways, VPN hub-and-spoke deployments, or standalone/off-grid system connectivity

• Scripting, API, or automation experience

• Prior experience as a lead technician, systems engineer, field engineer, or senior technical support engineer

What Success Looks Like

• Escalations come back with a root cause, not a reboot

• Design problems are caught on paper, before they cost a truck roll

• Networks are built to a standard instead of assembled per site

• Tier 1 gets better because there is a real escalation path

• Leadership stops having to personally solve every technical problem



Why These Roles

You'll own real systems, not tickets. The work spans device hardware, networking, platform configuration, and integration architecture across live client sites — with a direct line to the person setting technical direction. Both roles are fully remote, with real technical ownership and a defined path forward: Tier 1 into Tier 2/3, and Tier 2/3 into senior systems engineering.

Position Summary:



The HR Coordinator supports the HR Business Partner in the day-to-day administration and coordination of Human Resources activities across the company.

This is a hands-on coordination role responsible for keeping recruitment, hiring, onboarding, employee communication, HR documentation, scheduling, and internal HR activities organized and moving forward.

The HR Coordinator will regularly communicate with candidates, employees, Team Leads, and managers. Because the role has access to sensitive candidate, employee, compensation, performance, and company information, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment are essential.

The HR Coordinator supports the HRBP in executing HR processes but does not independently make sensitive employment, disciplinary, compensation, or policy decisions unless specifically authorized.

Key Responsibilities



Recruitment Coordination:



Support the HRBP with recruitment activities for open positions.

Conduct candidate outreach through approved recruitment platforms,
, and other channels.

Review applications and help organize candidates based on established hiring requirements.

Send interview invitations and communicate interview details to candidates.

Verify that required hiring documents have been received before onboarding.

Keep hiring records accurate, complete, and properly stored.



New Hire Onboarding:

Guide new employees through the company's onboarding process.

Explain required onboarding steps, company systems, HR procedures, and immediate expectations.

Coordinate required account or system setup with the appropriate internal teams.

Ensure employees receive required policies, agreements, checklists, and onboarding materials.

Track completion of required onboarding activities.

Coordinate the transition of each new hire from HR onboarding to their Team Lead.

Escalate missing documentation, onboarding concerns, or unusual situations to the HRBP.



HRBP Support:



Assist the HRBP with daily HR activities and administrative requirements.

Prepare documents, communications, schedules, and supporting information when requested.

Help maintain employee records and HR documentation.

Follow up with employees or managers regarding outstanding HR requirements.

Assist with employee lifecycle activities such as onboarding, probation tracking, employee documentation, changes in employment, and offboarding.

Gather information and conduct HR-related research when requested by the HRBP.

Assist with maintaining HR procedures, checklists, templates, and internal documentation.

Identify incomplete HR processes or records and bring them to the HRBP's attention.



Team Lead Coordination:

Coordinate meetings involving HR, employees, candidates, and management.

Candidate applications and interview information

Salaries and compensation information

Offer details

Employment agreements

Employee personal information

Performance information

Complaints or employee concerns

Disciplinary matters

Performance improvement plans

Terminations or potential terminations

Management discussions

HR investigations

Medical, leave, or personal information provided to HR

Internal HR communications

Company decisions that have not been formally communicated

Never discuss confidential HR matters casually with coworkers, friends, other employees, or managers who are not involved.

Never forward, copy, screenshot, download, or otherwise distribute confidential information without authorization.

Keep HR documents, accounts, passwords, systems, and communications secure.

Confirm with the HRBP before sharing information whenever you are unsure whether someone is authorized to receive it.



Immediately report any a
 or suspected disclosure of confidential information to the HRBP.



Unauthorized disclosure of confidential HR or company information will be considered a serious violation of company policy and will result in immediate disciplinary action, up to and including termination, subject to applicable law and company policy.

Professional communication with candidates and employees.

Reliability and accountability.
