, spreadsheets, shared documents, calendars, HR systems, and other business software.

title: Sales Development Consultant
description:
PropZap — Building the Future of Real Estate in North America



PropZap is building a next-generation real estate platform designed to expand across North America.

We are pioneers in how modern real estate companies should be built — powered by strong systems, smart technology, data-driven decision-making, and operational efficiency.



We're building with intention.

With structure.

With technology at the core.

With performance that compounds over time.



Our goal is to create a brand that sets the standard. A company that leads. A platform built to scale intelligently and sustainably across markets.



And for the right person, this isn't just a job inside that company.

It's a front-row seat to its growth.



--------------------------------------------------------------

Role: Sales Development Consultant

Location: Remote

Shift: Aligned with Canada MST

Role Type: Full-time

Compensation: To Be Discussed, plus bonuses on closed deals



We believe great people build great companies. If you can consistently turn qualified leads into happy, ready clients, we are willing to offer premium compensation, plus bonuses when your clients close. Strong performers who show up and follow through will be rewarded at the top end of the market.



--------------------------------------------------------------

Why This Role Is a Big Opportunity for You



Most roles like this bury you in cold outreach and rejection before you ever get to do the part you're actually good at. Here, you're not selling anyone on an idea — every inbound lead has already chosen PropZap before you even pick up the phone. That means your time and energy go toward actually helping people, not convincing them.



This role also isn't a dead end. It's one of the most important seats in the company — every client's journey passes through you first, which means your work directly shapes whether the business grows. And PropZap has real plans to expand into new markets across North America — being part of this team now means being part of building the systems and standards that carry us there.



That kind of visibility and impact is rare this early in a role, and it comes with a real path forward: as the team grows, this becomes a Team Lead position, overseeing other consultants instead of just working your own list.



And because your work is tied so directly to results, your compensation reflects that — premium pay, plus bonuses when your clients actually close. This is a ground-floor seat inside a company built to scale, and the people who join early and perform will be rewarded at the top end of the market.



--------------------------------------------------------------

What You'll Be Doing



- Build genuine rapport with every client from the very first conversation, so they feel supported and confident right away

- Meet inbound leads who've already booked a scheduled consultation and were already qualified by an appointment setter before they ever reach you — they know who we are, they're expecting your call, and there's no cold pitch involved

- Reach out to past leads who inquired before but went quiet — real outbound work, but reintroducing a genuine opportunity to someone who's already shown interest, not cold-calling a total stranger

- Guide them toward getting pre-approved, whether through their own broker or ours

- Help them create an account on our proprietary home search platform

- Walk them through setting their price range, preferred areas, and property criteria so their search actually matches what they want

- Show them how to book their own showings through our platform, coordinating with them along the way

- Follow up consistently on where they're at with their pre-approval, their search, and showings — checking in until they're ready for the next step

- Hand them off to their agent once pre-approval is complete and they're set up on the platform — clean and complete, with nothing left for the agent to chase down

- Keep our proprietary system updated with every conversation and status change, so nothing falls through the cracks

- Give every client a smooth, seamless experience from their very first call through to the moment they're ready to be connected to an agent



NOTE: Responsibilities in this role may evolve over time based on the company's needs as we grow.



--------------------------------------------------------------

Who This Is Perfect For



- Someone who's naturally good at building rapport quickly, and can make a client feel confident and taken care of from the very first call

- Someone who's comfortable coordinating several moving pieces for one client at a time — pre-approval, search setup, showings — without losing track of any of them

- Someone who's tech-savvy and picks up new software quickly, since you'll be working across both our client-facing platform and our own internal system

- Someone who's a genuine team player — happy to support agents, ask for help when needed, and pitch in wherever the team needs it as we grow together

- Someone who wants real stability with real upside, not just another grind

- Someone who takes pride in their own numbers and doesn't need to be micromanaged to hit them

- Experience in sales, appointment setting, lead qualification, or account management

- Strong, friendly phone presence

- Comfortable working inside software tools and digital platforms

- Organized enough to follow up consistently without being reminded

- Real estate experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement — basic familiarity with how buying or selling works is enough



--------------------------------------------------------------

What You'll Gain



- Premium compensation, plus bonuses when your clients close

- Long-term stability inside a company built for where real estate is heading, not where it's been

- Real tools and a real process behind you — our proprietary platform and internal system are built specifically to support this role, so you're never guessing

- A genuine team around you — people who support each other and grow together as the company scales

- A clear path toward a Team Lead role as the team grows

- The chance to grow with the company as we expand into new markets across North America



Imagine being two or three years into a company that's expanded across multiple markets — knowing you were there building real relationships with clients from day one, right alongside a team that grew right along with you.



--------------------------------------------------------------

How to Apply



Send the following to: 



- A short voice recording explaining why you're the best fit for this role (required)

- Resume (required)

- Portfolio (preferred)

- Expected monthly compensation in CAD (required)

- Any DISC test result (if available)



Subject Line: Sales Development Consultant – Your Name



--------------------------------------------------------------

If you're someone who genuinely enjoys building relationships, guiding people through a process, and wants to be the reason a business scales — this might be the role you've been waiting for.

.



We provide continuing education experiences for Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetists (CRNAs), including destination conferences, Disney cruises, Walt Disney World events, hands-on anesthesia workshops, and virtual education.



This is primarily an **execution role, not a strategy role**.



Our owner will create the weekly content plan, including the topic, hook, messaging direction, caption ideas, and a description of the footage needed. Your job will be to take that plan and turn it into polished social media content that is ready to publish.



## Responsibilities



* Review the weekly social media content plan

* Locate the appropriate video footage and photos inside our provided folders based on written descriptions

* Select the strongest clips to match each Reel or post

* Create and edit Instagram Reels, preferably using Instagram’s native editing tools

* Repurpose appropriate content between platforms

* Follow our brand guidelines, templates, and preferred Reel styles

* Make minor revisions when requested

* Check published posts for spelling, formatting, or other obvious errors



We currently publish approximately **7 pieces of content per week**.



## Finding Video Footage



You will not always be given the exact video clip to use.



Instead, you may receive instructions such as:



* Find footage of guests boarding a Disney cruise ship

* Find clips from a hands-on ultrasound workshop

* Find footage of families enjoying one of our conference events

* Find clips showing an airway demonstration

* Find Disney parks or cruise footage that fits a specific topic



You will be given access to organized video and photo folders and a reference guide explaining common procedures, activities, and terminology.



You do **not** need a healthcare or anesthesia background, but you must be comfortable carefully following descriptions and learning how to recognize the types of footage we use.



## What We Provide



* Weekly content plan and strategy

* Topics, hooks, and messaging direction

* Video and photo library

* Brand guidelines

* Canva templates

* Examples of previous posts

* Instructions for common Reel techniques

* Clear feedback and expectations



## Skills We Are Looking For



* Experience creating Instagram Reels

* Strong knowledge of Instagram’s native Reel editing tools

* Good understanding of hooks, pacing, text placement, and trending audio

* Canva experience

* Experience with Instagram and

* Good visual judgment

* Ability to choose strong video clips from a larger media library

* Excellent attention to detail

* Good written English

* Ability to follow instructions accurately

* Reliable communication

* Ability to work independently without needing constant direction

* Organized and able to meet weekly deadlines



Experience with travel, healthcare, education, conferences, or lifestyle brands is a plus but not required.



## Hours



Approximately **5–7 hours per week** to start.



Hours may increase as our business and social media needs grow.



## Pay



**$5–$7 USD per hour**, depending on experience and skill level.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position who can become familiar with our brand and content library.

title: DaVinci Resolve Editor — Aerial ,Brand AND Corporate Films | Long-Term Role, We Train You
description:
We are Solent Sky Services, a UK aerial film and video production company. We shoot

from the air and the ground for commercial clients, and we produce our own content

for social media. We are looking for one video editor to become our in-house editing

partner - long term, exclusively with us. 



This is not a per-project gig. We want to find the right person, train them properly

on our systems, and build the role around them. We start at around 20 hours a week and

move to full time as our volume grows. Where it goes from there is up to how far you

want to take it - our ambition is to support the right editor in building out a proper

post-production setup of their own, with us as the anchor client.



WHAT YOU WILL BE EDITING



- Client projects: brand films, corporate and case study pieces, property and

  construction, events. These need narrative drive, clean pacing and a professional

  finish.

- Our own social advertising: short-form, fast, stylish kinetic edits that stop the

  scroll on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube Shorts.



You will work with aerial and ground footage, often log/flat profiles that need

grading, and a mix of proxy and original media depending on the job.



THE WORKFLOW



- DaVinci Resolve, non-negotiable. We work collaboratively in Resolve, so you must be

  comfortable working inside a shared project structure rather than editing in

  isolation and sending files back.

- Proxy and original media workflows - generating proxies, relinking to originals,

  and understanding when to use which.

- Clean, disciplined project organisation. Named bins, labelled timelines, versioned

  cuts. If someone else opens your project, it should make sense immediately.

- Cloud transfer of media and outputs.



If you already work this way, great. If you know Resolve well but have not done

collaborative or proxy workflows before, we will train you. We would rather teach the

process to a good editor than hire a fast editor with bad habits.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- A genuinely good editor. Rhythm, timing, and an instinct for what to cut. We can

  teach software; we cannot teach taste.

- Someone who wants to keep learning. New tools, new techniques, new formats.

- Someone who watches what is working right now - trends, formats, sound design,

  what platforms are rewarding this month - and brings ideas to us rather than waiting

  to be told.

- Reliable and communicative. You hit deadlines, and if something is going to slip,

  you tell us early.

- Comfortable working with a UK-based team (GMT/BST). We are flexible on your hours,

  but there should be some overlap with the UK working day.

- Looking for one long-term client rather than juggling several. We will be asking

  for exclusivity as the hours build, and we will make it worth your while.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Full training on our systems, workflow and house style. You will not be dropped in

  and left to guess.

- Stable, predictable work with one client, not feast-and-famine freelancing.

- Genuine progression: hours, rate and responsibility all grow as you do.

- Support in building your own post-production capability over time.

- Interesting footage and diverse range of projects.



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- Fusion or After Effects for motion graphics and titles

- Colour grading with LUTs and node-based correction in Resolve

- Sound design and audio cleanup in Fairlight

- Experience with drone footage (DJI,, RED RAW, log profiles)

- Basic graphic design for thumbnails and social assets

- Subtitling and captioning



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A showreel or 2-3 links to work you edited yourself. Tell us exactly what you did

   on each - if you did not edit it, do not send it.

2. One example of a short-form social edit and one example of something longer and

   more narrative or corporate. If you only have one of those, send what you have and

   say so.

3. A short note on your DaVinci Resolve experience: how long, what version, whether

   you have used collaborative projects or proxy workflows.

4. Your internet speed (a screenshot of a speed test), your computer specs, and your

   available hours per week in your local time.

5. Start your message with the word RESOLVE so we know you read this properly.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short PAID test edit using our own footage.



We do not ask anyone to work for free.

title: Junior AI Automation Specialist – n8n & AI Tools
description:
# Junior AI Automation Specialist – n8n & AI Tools



**Remote | Full-Time | Philippines**

**Entry-Level / Junior Position**



## About Us



We are a growing cabinetry and custom millwork company based in San Jose, California. Our team works across sales, marketing, design, estimating, manufacturing, installation, customer service, and business operations.



We are actively introducing AI and automation into our daily workflows and are looking for a **Junior AI Automation Specialist** to help us build, test, maintain, and improve practical AI-powered tools and automations.



This is a **junior-level position**.



We are **not looking for a senior AI engineer or an expert who already knows everything**.



We are looking for someone who is technically curious, logical, reliable, and excited about figuring out how AI and automation can solve real business problems.



If you enjoy experimenting with ChatGPT, Claude, n8n, APIs, automation tools, or building small technical projects on your own, we would like to hear from you.



## What You’ll Do



Your main job will be to help turn repetitive manual processes into simple, reliable automated workflows.



You will:



* Build and maintain workflows using **n8n**

* Work with tools such as Make, Zapier, Google Workspace, CRM systems,
 platforms, and other business software

* Connect different applications using APIs and webhooks

* Use AI models such as ChatGPT / OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini inside business workflows

* Build simple AI-powered assistants and internal tools

* Help automate data entry, lead processing, follow-ups, reporting, notifications, and other repetitive tasks

* Use AI to extract, organize, classify, summarize, and process information

* Test automations carefully before deployment

* Troubleshoot and repair workflows when something breaks

* Monitor existing automations and improve their reliability

* Document workflows, logic, account connections, and troubleshooting steps

* Research new AI tools and determine whether they could improve our operations

* Work with our team to understand business problems and translate them into automation workflows



## Examples of Projects You May Work On



You may help us build automations such as:



**Lead Management**



Website inquiry

→ Capture customer information

→ AI classifies the lead

→ Save information to CRM or Google Sheets

→ Notify the correct salesperson

→ Generate a follow-up draft



*
 & Project Information**



Incoming project

→ AI reads the message

→ Extract project name, company, deadline, scope, and contact information

→ Organize the information

→ Create a task or record

→ Notify the appropriate team member



**Sales Follow-Up**



Salesperson enters meeting notes

→ AI organizes the notes

→ Creates a CRM summary

→ Generates a follow-up

→ Schedules a reminder if the customer does not respond



**Reporting**



Collect information from different sources

→ Clean and organize the data

→ Update a dashboard or spreadsheet

→ Generate a simple AI summary for management



**Internal AI Tools**



Build lightweight tools that help our team search information, summarize documents, organize project information, generate drafts, or complete repetitive tasks faster.



These are examples only. Part of the role is continuously identifying other tasks that can be improved through AI and automation.



## Core Tools



You will primarily work with or learn:



* **n8n**

* ChatGPT / OpenAI

* Claude

* Gemini

* Google Sheets

* Gmail / Google Workspace

* APIs

* Webhooks

* JSON

* CRM systems

* Make / Zapier

* GitHub



You may also use AI coding tools such as:



* Claude Code

* Cursor

* Codex

* GitHub Copilot



We do **not** expect you to already be an expert in every tool listed above.



Being able to learn new tools quickly is more important.



## What We’re Looking For



We care strongly about **how you think and learn**, not just how many years of experience you have.



You should be someone who:



* Enjoys solving technical problems

* Likes figuring out how systems work

* Is comfortable learning from documentation, tutorials, YouTube, ChatGPT, Claude, and other resources

* Can break a problem into logical steps

* Tests your work instead of assuming it works

* Pays attention to details

* Is reliable and follows through

* Can work independently after receiving clear direction

* Is comfortable saying, “I don't know yet, but I will figure it out”

* Can explain technical problems in simple English

* Documents what you build

* Is interested in AI and actively experiments with new tools

* Wants to develop long-term skills in AI automation



## Technical Foundation



You should have at least a basic understanding of:



* Automation logic

* APIs

* Webhooks

* JSON

* Data flow between applications

* Basic programming logic



Experience with **JavaScript or Python** is preferred, but you do not need to be an advanced developer.



For example, you should eventually be comfortable using JavaScript or Python for simple tasks such as:



* Formatting data

* Cleaning text

* Manipulating arrays

* Processing JSON

* Working with dates

* Making API requests



Using ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or other AI coding tools to help you write and debug code is encouraged.



## AI Skills



You should have hands-on experience experimenting with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.



You should understand or be interested in learning how AI can be used for:



* Information extraction

* Classification

* Summarization

* Structured output

* Content generation

* Data processing

* Prompt design

* AI assistants

* Tool calling

* Simple AI agents



Advanced experience with RAG, MCP, vector databases, or multi-agent systems is **not required** for this position.



You may have opportunities to learn these technologies as your skills develop.



## Education & Experience



Ideal candidates may have:



* 0–2 years of relevant experience

* A degree or current studies in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field



However, a technical degree is **not required** if you can demonstrate strong hands-on ability.



We welcome:



* Recent graduates

* Students with strong project experience

* Self-taught developers

* Career changers with technical skills

* Candidates who have built personal AI or automation projects



School projects, personal projects, GitHub projects, and experimental automations are all welcome.



## Nice to Have



The following are helpful but **not required**:



* Previous n8n experience

* Make or Zapier

* JavaScript

* Python

* GitHub

* Supabase

* Airtable

* Basic SQL

* CRM integrations

* Web scraping

* Claude Code or Cursor

* Basic database knowledge

* Basic RAG knowledge

* Experience building simple AI agents

* Experience creating internal tools



We want someone with a **good technical foundation and strong learning ability who can grow into more advanced work over time.**



## Schedule



* Full-time remote position

* Philippines-based candidates preferred

* Most technical work can be completed independently

* Some overlap with U.S. Pacific Time will be needed for meetings, project discussions, and testing

* Long-term position for the right person



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume

2. A short introduction about yourself

3. A **1–2 minute Loom video in English** introducing yourself and explaining why AI automation interests you

4. Links to GitHub, portfolio, n8n workflows, or any technical projects you have built, if available



School projects and personal projects are completely acceptable.



Please answer the following questions:



**1. What AI and automation tools have you used?**



**2. Have you used n8n, Make, or Zapier? Tell us about one workflow you have built.**



If you have never used n8n, explain what similar tools you have used.



**3. What is an API? Explain it in simple language as if you were explaining it to a non-technical manager.**



**4. Imagine this workflow:**



A customer submits a form on our website containing their name,
, phone number, company, and message.



We want AI to determine whether the customer is a homeowner, contractor, designer, or builder, save the information, notify the correct salesperson, and prepare a follow-up
.



**Briefly explain how you would build this workflow.**



You do not need to provide code. We want to understand how you think.



**5. Tell us about something technical you did not know how to do at first but taught yourself successfully. How did you figure it out?**



**6. Which AI tool do you currently use the most, and what do you use it for?**



## Practical Test



Candidates who pass the first interview may be invited to complete a **short paid practical test**.



The test may involve building a simple automation using n8n, an AI model, Google Sheets, and an API or webhook.



We care more about your **problem-solving process, logic, testing, and ability to learn** than whether you already know every feature.



## Who Will Do Well Here



You may be a great fit if you are the kind of person who sees a repetitive task and immediately thinks:



**“There has to be a better way to automate this.”**



You don't need to know everything today.



But you should enjoy learning, experimenting, building, testing, fixing, and continuously making systems better.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term as AI becomes a bigger part of how our company operates.

ReloCovered is a U.S.-based temporary housing company that helps families find furnished housing when they are displaced from their homes due to fire, water damage, insurance claims, renovations, and other covered losses.



We are looking for an **experienced Temporary Housing Placement Coordinator** who understands the insurance relocation and corporate housing industry.



**This position is specifically for candidates with temporary housing, corporate housing, insurance relocation, ALE, leasing, or similar housing-placement experience.**



### Responsibilities



* Manage temporary housing requests from initial intake through completed placement

* Review each family's housing requirements, location, budget, move-in date, pets, bedrooms, school needs, and other requirements

* Source appropriate furnished and unfurnished properties

* Contact landlords, property managers, real estate agents, and property owners

* Verify availability and property details

* Negotiate rental rates, deposits, lease terms, utilities, furnishings, and extensions

* Present housing options for approval

* Communicate with insurance relocation companies, adjusters, policyholders, landlords, and agents

* Follow up consistently until the housing placement is approved and secured

* Coordinate rental applications and screening through approved secure systems

* Prepare and coordinate lease documentation

* Coordinate move-in details

* Manage lease extensions when additional temporary housing is required

* Maintain accurate notes and status updates for every housing case

* Protect confidential company pricing, negotiated rates, client information, and business margins

* Work closely with ReloCovered management to successfully complete placements



### Experience We Are Looking For



**Strong preference will be given to applicants who have previously worked for:**



* Temporary housing companies

* Insurance relocation companies

* Corporate housing companies

* ALE / Additional Living Expense housing providers

* Property insurance claims organizations

* Furnished housing companies

* Relocation companies

* Mid-term rental companies



Experience working with insurance adjusters, displaced policyholders, landlords, real estate agents, and property managers is highly preferred.



Existing experience or relationships within the **insurance temporary-housing industry** is a major advantage.



### You Should Be Able To:



* Understand how an insurance temporary-housing placement works from beginning to end

* Speak confidently with U.S. landlords, agents, adjusters, and clients

* Negotiate rental terms professionally

* Search quickly for properties that meet specific housing requirements

* Manage multiple active housing placements simultaneously

* Follow up aggressively and professionally

* Keep every case organized and documented

* Work independently and solve problems

* Communicate clearly in written and spoken English

* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding pricing and client information



### Ideal Candidate



We are especially interested in someone who has **already worked inside the temporary housing / insurance relocation industry** and can bring real-world knowledge of how placements are handled.



We do not want to train someone from zero on what temporary housing is.



We want someone who understands the industry and can help ReloCovered grow its housing-placement operation.

title: Social Media Marketing
description:
Fan Page & Social Media Assistant



Position: Part-Time, Remote

Compensation: $500 CAD/month + Performance Bonuses

Hours: Approximately 15 hours/week

Trial Period:1 week



About the Role



We're looking for a creative, internet-savvy person to help run and grow a network of music fan pages.



The ideal candidate must understand internet culture and have a natural sense for what makes content funny, relatable, emotional, aesthetic, or shareable.



You should genuinely enjoy **K-dramas, anime, music edits, memes, music, and online fan culture.



## The Goal



The main goal is to **reach new listeners from different angles using the music**.



Instead of simply posting the song and asking people to listen, we want to introduce the music through content people already enjoy.



This could include:



* Memes

* K-drama edits

* Anime edits

* Music edits

* Relatable videos

* Romantic/emotional content

* Aesthetic content

* Fan content

* Creative uses of lyrics and song moments

* Internet trends and formats



The goal is to make people discover the music naturally through content they already enjoy, and turn those viewers into new listeners and fans.



Responsibilities



* Manage 5 fan accounts, each with a different content theme and identity

* Post several times per day across the accounts

* Create content specifically designed around the artist's music and audio

* Find creative ways to use the songs in memes, edits, relatable content, and short-form videos

* Create K-drama edits, anime edits, music edits, and other creative edits

* Turn lyrics and specific moments from songs into shareable content

* Repurpose existing music videos, performances, photos, interviews, and other content

* Create simple edits, memes, clips, and fan-focused content

* Engage with comments and interact with the fan community

* Find and repost relevant fan-created content

* Monitor other fan pages and artists for inspiration

* Experiment with different content styles and formats

* Track which types of posts perform best

* Provide a simple weekly performance report

* Develop new creative ideas for reaching potential listeners



The 5 Accounts



Each account should have its  own personality and content strategy rather than simply reposting the same thing.



 1. Memes & Relatable Content



Relationship memes, funny situations, relatable posts, lyrics, internet humor, and situations people can connect with.



 2. K-Drama Edits



Romantic K-drama scenes, emotional moments, character edits, aesthetic clips, and other K-drama content paired with the music.



 3. Anime Edits



Anime scenes, emotional moments, character relationships, cinematic clips, and creative anime edits using the music.



 4. Aesthetic & Music Edits



Dreamy, cinematic, emotional, and visually appealing edits built specifically around the songs, lyrics, and overall aesthetic.



 5. Fan & Discovery



Fan content, interesting artist moments, lyrics, clips, music discoveries, behind-the-scenes content, and more experimental content designed to introduce new people to the music.



The themes can evolve based on what performs best.



 Requirements



Must have:



* Strong understanding of internet culture

* Very familiar with TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

* Strong understanding of memes and online humor

* Genuine interest in K-dramas and anime

* Enjoys making or watching edits

* Understands online fan culture

* Good sense of humor and creativity

* Good instincts for what makes content shareable

* Reliable and consistent

* Good written English



Bonus:



* Experience running fan pages

* Experience growing social media accounts

* Experience making music, anime, or K-drama edits

* Familiarity with CapCut, Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar editing software

* Experience with K-pop, K-drama, anime, music, or other online fandoms



 What We're Looking For



We're not looking for someone who simply knows how to upload posts.



We want someone who can hear a song and immediately think of multiple ways it could be used online.



For example:



"This lyric would make a perfect K-drama edit."



"This part of the song would work as an anime edit."



"This could be a funny meme."



"This song fits this relationship scenario perfectly."



The goal is to constantly find new angles to introduce people to the music.



Success



Success isn't just about how many posts are uploaded.



We'll look at:



* Views and reach

* Shares and saves

* Engagement

* Follower growth

* Fan-generated content

* New listeners

* Which accounts and content formats perform best

* Whether the accounts are reaching audiences who wouldn't otherwise discover the music



 Compensation & Schedule



$500 CAD/month



Approximately 15 hours per week, with flexibility in when you work.



Performance Bonuses



There is also potential for **additional bonuses when content performs exceptionally well, particularly when posts reach significant view counts or generate meaningful engagement and new listeners.



The specific bonus structure can be discussed and agreed upon based on performance.



 1-Week Trial



The first week will be a paid trial period for both sides to see if the role is a good fit.



During the trial, we'll look at the quality and consistency of the content, creativity, understanding of internet culture, communication, and overall fit for the role.



If the trial goes well, the position will continue at $500 CAD/month, with the opportunity to earn additional performance bonuses.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Any fan pages or social media accounts you've managed

3. Examples of edits, TikToks, Reels, or Shorts you've created

4. Your favorite song from the artist

5. 3 fan-page content ideas using the music

6. Your availability and time zone



We're looking for someone who loves the internet, understands fan culture, loves memes, anime, K-dramas and edits, and can find creative ways to turn a song into content people want to share.

title: Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist
description:
Who We Are:



At Escend Media, we help D2C brands implement retention strategies that increase profit and drive customer retention. We want to be the ‘who’ behind
s that people ask ‘dannngg, who designed that’.



What We Do:

We help 7 and 8 figure ecommerce businesses develop, optimize and scale their owned media marketing efforts. Whether they are just looking to start
 marketing, they need to really refine what they are currently doing or they need someone to take
 marketing off their shoulders, we’re here to help them so that they can focus on running the business.



Our clients are leaders in their industry and have built strong relationships with the customers they serve. Our job is to ensure that their brand image stays consistent online and offline and, more importantly, that their business is growing.





Summary of The Position:



The Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist is responsible for the strategic implementation and optimization of post-purchase upsell funnels, primarily utilizing platforms like Aftersell. This role focuses on enhancing Average Order Value (AOV) and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) for Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce brands by creating highly relevant and effective post-purchase offers. The specialist will manage the full lifecycle of implementation, from strategic planning and A/B testing to performance monitoring and continuous optimization, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with brand objectives.



Responsibilities:



• Implement and manage post-purchase upsell funnels using platforms such as Aftersell, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives to increase AOV and CLTV.

• Conduct systematic A/B testing across various elements including product selection, offer and pricing structures, pricing angles, copywriting, psychological angles, user interface (UI) optimization, and customer segmentation.

• Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Acceptance Rate, AOV Lift, Incremental Profit/Session, and Upsell Conversion Rate, optimizing for Revenue Per Visitor (RPV) and Profit Per Visitor (PPV).

• Ensure technical and creative requirements are met for all implementations, including fulfillment safety (e.g., 'Order on Hold' feature), mobile responsiveness, brand consistency, and effective inventory management.

• Collaborate with marketing and design teams to ensure brand consistency and compelling offer presentation.

• Identify and avoid common pitfalls such as the 'Wall of Text' error and the 'Irrelevance' trap, focusing on clear value propositions and relevant offers.

• Leverage customer data, loyalty programs, and other add-ons to enhance post-purchase strategies and maximize incremental revenue.

• Continuously refine and improve post-purchase strategies based on performance data and evolving market trends.



Our Culture:



• No one is bigger than the team

• We don’t make excuses, we take responsibility

• Innovate everywhere

• Communicate. Communicate. Communicate. We have a culture of open communication.



Required Skills:



• Proven experience in implementing and optimizing post-purchase upsell strategies, preferably with platforms like Aftersell.

• Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics and their impact on business growth (AOV, CLTV, ROAS, RPV, PPV).

• Demonstrated expertise in A/B testing methodologies and data-driven optimization.

• Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to quality assurance in all implementations.

• Knowledge of mobile UI/UX best practices for e-commerce.

• Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.

• Experience with project management software (e.g., Clickup) is a plus.

• Proactive approach with a sense of urgency and purpose in daily tasks.



Perks:

- Flexible working hours

- Remote working

- Room to grow - we're an early stage start up with a proven track record

- Competitive compensation

- Work with some amazing brands



This Role Is Perfect for You If…



- You love working as a team.

- You are a self-starter.

- You can work under pressure

- You have exceptional communication skills

- You are results/outcome driven.

- You have a ‘can-do’ attitude. If “that’s not my job” isn’t in your vocabulary, you’ll fit in great!



This Role is NOT the Right Fit For You If You Are…

- A ‘me first’ type of person

- Not a self-starter.

- Not a ‘people person’

- Problem driven, not solution oriented. If you complain about problems/issues/bottlenecks, without proposing a solution, this is not for you.

- Looking for a typical 9-5. If you hate Mondays, this is not for you. We’re a mission-driven company who are all about changing the lives and businesses that we work with. If we have something that needs to get done, we’ll have all hands on deck. Sometimes you might have to work late but sometimes you’ll get the afternoon off, it’s not all work no play, but we’re here to help business grow!

HOURS PER WEEK

JOB OVERVIEW



ABOUT DIVERGENT ESTATES



Divergent Estates is a growing U.S.-based short-term rental management company. We help property owners operate professional, guest-ready vacation rentals across multiple U.S. markets.



We are hiring a long-term, full-time Short-Term Rental Property Operations Manager. Internally, we call this role a Pod Manager.



This is not a general virtual assistant or customer-service-only position. It is an ownership role for someone who can build the operating team around a small group of properties and then manage those properties from A to Z.



HOW THE ROLE STARTS



You will be assigned a small number of target properties before they are fully transitioned to you.



For each property, you will:



- Validate and organize the property information

- Build the primary and backup cleaning team

- Build the local maintenance and specialty-vendor bench

- Document contacts, procedures and escalation paths in Notion

- Configure HostBuddy AI so it can answer routine guest questions

- Review the PriceLabs setup and learn the approved pricing guardrails

- Identify open problems and create a stabilization plan

- Pass a property-readiness review



Once the property passes the readiness review, you will formally accept responsibility for it. Properties will transfer to you one at a time, so you will own the team and operating system you helped build.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Cleaner scheduling, performance, inspections and backup coverage

- Maintenance intake, troubleshooting, vendor dispatch and completion follow-through

- Daytime guest issues that HostBuddy AI cannot resolve

- Proactive owner communication and documented decisions

- Property supplies, recurring services and operational readiness

- Accurate property and vendor information in Notion

- PriceLabs execution within approved company guardrails

- Open tasks from the first report through verified completion

- Operational onboarding for additional properties assigned to your pod



PriceLabs ownership includes monitoring calendar health, minimum-stay rules, orphan gaps, local events and approved overrides. Major pricing strategy and changes outside the approved guardrails require company approval until you complete our internal certification.



✅ REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Excellent spoken and written English

- Confidence making phone calls to U.S.-based cleaners, handymen and vendors

- Experience in short-term rentals, property management, hospitality operations or a comparable operations role

- Strong problem-solving and prioritization under time pressure

- Ability to troubleshoot maintenance issues before sending a vendor

- Clear documentation and disciplined follow-through

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace and a professional call setup

- Ability to work full time without overlapping full-time employment

- Comfort accepting responsibility for results, not only completing assigned tasks



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE



Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:



- Hostaway or another property management system

- Breezeway or another cleaning and maintenance platform

- PriceLabs or another revenue-management tool

- Notion, Slack or remote documentation systems

 what to do?

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant to Founder / CEO



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | Australian Business Hours



About the Role



I’m an Australian entrepreneur operating multiple growing businesses across education, retail, eCommerce, software and the barbering industry.



I’m looking for an exceptional Executive Assistant to work directly with me as the Founder/CEO and become a key part of our business operations.



This is not a basic Virtual Assistant role.



I’m looking for someone highly organised, proactive, commercially minded and confident enough to take ownership of responsibilities without needing constant instructions.



Your job is to help me operate at a higher level by protecting my time, keeping me organised, coordinating with my teams and making sure important tasks actually get completed.



You will become the central point between me and different people across our businesses.



The right person will eventually know what needs to happen before I need to ask.



⸻



Your Core Responsibilities



1. Executive Calendar Management



You will take ownership of my calendar and schedule.



Responsibilities include:



* Managing my daily and weekly calendar

* Scheduling internal and external meetings

* Rescheduling appointments when required

* Preventing scheduling conflicts

* Coordinating meetings across different team members

* Protecting blocks of time for important work

* Making sure I have enough travel/preparation time between commitments

* Reminding me of important meetings and deadlines

* Making sure meetings have a clear purpose before being added to my calendar



You should be comfortable managing a busy founder’s schedule and making sensible decisions about priorities.



⸻



2.
 & Inbox Management



You will help manage and organise my inbox.



This includes:



* Reviewing incoming
s

* Identifying urgent or important messages

* Organising and categorising
s

* Drafting responses for my approval

* Responding to routine
s where authorised

* Following up unanswered
s

* Making sure important conversations don’t get forgotten

* Unsubscribing and removing unnecessary inbox clutter

* Keeping my inbox organised



The goal is that I should not need to spend hours every day processing
.



⸻



3. Daily Founder Organisation



Every morning, I want a clear understanding of what requires my attention.



You will prepare a daily executive summary including:



Today’s Priorities



The most important things I need to complete.



Today’s Meetings



What meetings I have and anything I need to know beforehand.



Waiting on Others



Tasks or information we are waiting for from employees, suppliers or external partners.



Needs Approval



Anything that requires a decision from me.



Important Updates



Anything across the businesses that I should know about.



You will also help ensure unfinished priorities don’t disappear.



⸻



4. Task & Project Management



You will maintain a central system for my tasks and commitments.



Responsibilities include:



* Turning conversations and voice notes into actionable tasks

* Assigning tasks to the correct team member

* Recording deadlines

* Following up outstanding tasks

* Maintaining project/task management software

* Tracking commitments made during meetings

* Escalating overdue or important items

* Preparing weekly outstanding-task reports



If I say:



“We need to get this done.”



I want you to make sure it becomes a tracked task with an owner and deadline rather than disappearing into a conversation.



⸻



5. Team Accountability & Follow-Up



A major part of your position will be following up with people on my behalf.



You may communicate with:



* Managers

* Sales teams

* Marketing teams

* Contractors

* Accountants

* Bookkeepers

* Developers

* Suppliers

* Agencies

* Business partners



You will:



* Request updates

* Chase overdue work

* Collect reports

* Confirm deadlines

* Schedule meetings

* Document commitments

* Escalate issues when required



You must be comfortable professionally holding people accountable.



⸻



6. Meeting Management



For important meetings, you will help with:



Before meetings:



* Prepare agenda

* Collect relevant documents

* Gather KPIs/information

* Identify outstanding actions from previous meetings



During/after meetings:



* Take or organise meeting notes

* Extract decisions

* Create action items

* Assign owners

* Add deadlines

* Follow up until actions are completed



Meetings should create action, not just conversation.



⸻



7. Business Reporting & KPI Collection



You will help me maintain visibility across multiple businesses.



You may be responsible for collecting and organising information including:



* Weekly revenue

* Sales performance

* Leads generated

* Conversion rates

* Marketing performance

* Staffing information

* Outstanding projects

* Business expenses

* Operational issues

* Customer/student metrics



You are not expected to be an accountant.



Your responsibility is to make sure the correct information reaches me in a clear and organised format.



⸻



8. Recruitment & HR Administration



You will assist with recruitment as our companies grow.



Responsibilities may include:



* Creating and posting job advertisements

* Organising applicants

* Initial candidate screening

* Shortlisting candidates

* Scheduling interviews

* Sending interview reminders

* Coordinating reference checks

* Preparing onboarding documentation

* Maintaining employee records

* Following up required paperwork



⸻



9. Research



You should be comfortable conducting detailed online research.



Examples include:



* Competitor research

* Supplier research

* Software comparisons

* Recruitment research

* Market research

* Pricing comparisons

* Business opportunities

* Potential partnerships

* Travel research

* Product research



I don’t just want links.



I want information summarised clearly so I can make a decision quickly.



⸻



10. Finance & Administration Support



You may assist with:



* Organising invoices

* Organising receipts

* Preparing documents for accountants/bookkeepers

* Following up invoices

* Maintaining expense records

* Gathering financial reports

* Liaising with accountants

* Tracking subscriptions and renewals

* Organising financial documents



You will not initially have unrestricted authority to move company funds or make major financial decisions.



⸻



11. Travel & Personal Administration



From time to time, you may also assist with personal executive administration.



Examples include:



* Flight research

* Hotel research

* Travel itineraries

* Restaurant reservations

* Appointment scheduling

* Event bookings

* Reminders

* Renewals

* Personal purchases/research



The purpose is to remove low-value administrative work from my schedule so I can focus on growing the companies.



⸻



What I’m Looking For



You should be:



* Extremely organised

* Reliable

* Proactive

* Detail-oriented

* Confident

* Resourceful

* Fast-moving

* Comfortable with responsibility

* Excellent at written English

* A strong communicator

* Comfortable working directly with a Founder/CEO

* Able to manage multiple priorities

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable following people up

* Good at identifying problems before they become bigger problems



Most importantly:



I don’t want someone who waits all day for instructions.



If you notice something hasn’t been completed, follow it up.



If a deadline is approaching, remind the relevant person.



If something doesn’t make sense, ask.



If you can solve something without unnecessarily involving me, solve it.



If something requires my decision, give me the information I need to make that decision quickly.



⸻



What Success Looks Like



After several months working together:



* My calendar is organised.

* My inbox is under control.

* I know my priorities every morning.

* Important tasks aren’t forgotten.

* Team members are being followed up.

* Meetings result in documented actions.

* Reports arrive before I need to ask for them.

* Documents are organised.

* Deadlines are being tracked.

* I spend significantly less time on administration.

* I have better visibility across my businesses.



Ultimately, your job is to give me back time and increase the speed at which our companies operate.



⸻



Software & Tools



Experience with some of the following is beneficial:



* Google Workspace

* Gmail

* Google Calendar

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* Microsoft Office

* Slack

* ClickUp / Asana / Monday / Notion

* ChatGPT and other AI tools

* CRM platforms

* Canva



You don’t need experience with every platform.



You do need to be technologically confident and capable of learning new software quickly.



⸻



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position based in the Philippines.



You must be comfortable working hours that substantially overlap with Melbourne, Australia business hours (AEST/AEDT).



Exact working hours will be discussed with the successful candidate.



⸻



Salary



Up to ₱100,000 PHP per month depending on experience and capability.



We are prepared to pay well for an exceptional candidate.



There will also be opportunities for:



* Performance bonuses

* Salary progression

* Increased responsibility

* Long-term career development



For the right person, this is intended to be a long-term position, not a short-term VA contract.



As the businesses grow, I want this role to grow with them.



⸻



Career Opportunity



There is significant opportunity for advancement.



Someone exceptional could progress from:



Executive Assistant



→ Senior Executive Assistant



→ Executive Operations Manager



→ Chief of Staff / Operations Leadership



I value people who take ownership, develop their capabilities and want to grow alongside the businesses they work with.



⸻



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your previous Executive Assistant / Virtual Assistant experience.

3. An example of a time you proactively solved a problem for an executive or business owner without being asked.

4. The software/platforms you are confident using.

5. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

6. Your availability to start.

7. A short 60–90 second video introduction explaining why you believe you would be excellent in this role.



Important Application Instruction



At the very beginning of your application, write:



“READY TO EXECUTE”



Applications that don’t include this phrase will not be considered.



We receive a large number of applications and attention to detail is extremely important for this position.



If you’re ambitious, organised, highly accountable and want the opportunity to become the right hand to an entrepreneur building multiple companies, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Direct-Response Video Editor – High-Converting VSLs & Paid Social Ads
description:
Hey, thanks for checking us out.



We're a German health and supplement brand growing fast with our ads on
 and Instagram. We're looking for a really good video editor to turn our scripts into VSLs and short ads that grab people and keep them watching.



Our ads are emotional. They speak to real problems real women deal with every day. Your edit needs to make people feel something in the first few seconds and hold them all the way to the end. That's the most important part.



Here's how we start:



No free test tasks, no hoops to jump through. We hand you a real script and you make one test ad for us. We pay you for it. If we love your work and it feels right on both sides, you're in and we work together long term. That simple.



We're not looking for one quick project. We want someone to grow with us. If you're good, there's steady work here and a team that actually values you.



What you'll do:



Edit VSLs and short ads (around 30 to 90 seconds, sometime even longer) for
 and Instagram

Build strong hooks that stop people from scrolling

Cut to the emotional beats so every line hits

Add b-roll, clips, text, captions, music and sound that fit the message

Work with AI avatar videos and AI visuals (we'll show you our setup)

Make a few versions so we can test what works best



What we're looking for:



Real experience editing ads or VSLs, not wedding or vlog work. Show us actual examples.

A great feel for pacing and emotion

Solid skills in Premiere Pro or After Effects (CapCut works too)

You understand how ads work: hooks, retention, getting the click

You're fast, reliable and open to feedback

Good written English so you can follow our briefs



A nice bonus, totally optional:



If you know a little German, that would be amazing. A lot of our footage and voiceovers are in German, so even a bit helps you edit the VSLs better and faster. If you don't speak any German, no worries at all. You'll get scripts, timestamps and notes so you always know what every line means and where the emotional 
nts are.

How to apply:



Just so we know you really read this:



Start your message with STOP-THE-SCROLL

Send 2 or 3 links to ads or VSLs you've actually edited

In a sentence or two, tell us about one ad you made that did well and why it worked

Let us know your hours and your rate



We read every application ourselves and reply to the ones that stand out. We're genuinely excited to find the right person, so show us what you've got. Talk soon.

title: Google Ads Manager – E-Commerce & Investment Campaigns
description:
ob Type: Part-Time initially, with potential for long-term/full-time work

Start: Immediately

Location: Remote – Philippines preferred

Experience: 3+ years of proven Google Ads experience

Industry: E-Commerce / Clothing / Investment



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Google Ads Manager / Google Ads Specialist who can start immediately and take responsibility for managing and optimising our Google advertising campaigns.



We operate an online clothing business and want to significantly increase sales through Google Ads. We are looking for someone who understands how to advertise individual products and product categories, rather than simply running generic search campaigns.



You must be commercially minded and focused on generating actual sales and profitable ROAS, not simply generating clicks or impressions.



There will also be a second project involving the creation and management of a Google Ads campaign for an investment opportunity connected to our company.



Main Responsibilities – Clothing E-Commerce



You will be responsible for:



* Reviewing our existing website and Google Ads/Google Merchant Center setup.

* Identifying the products with the greatest sales potential.

* Creating highly targeted Google Shopping / Performance Max / Search campaigns.

* Setting up campaigns around specific products, brands, categories and high-intent searches.

* Reviewing product feeds and identifying any Merchant Center issues.

* Optimising product titles, descriptions, images and other information where required for advertising performance.

* Managing bids, budgets, keywords, audiences and search terms.

* Monitoring conversions and ensuring proper conversion tracking is installed.

* Analysing which products are actually producing profitable sales.

* Cutting wasted advertising spend.

* Scaling campaigns that are performing well.

* Continuously testing different products, audiences, keywords, ads and campaign structures.

* Providing regular reports showing spend, revenue, conversions, CPA and ROAS.



Sales Is the Priority



We are not looking for someone who simply manages an advertising account.



We want someone who understands e-commerce and can help us generate as many profitable sales as possible.



You should be able to look at our website and say:



“These products should be advertised first, this is how I would structure the campaigns, this is the budget I recommend, and this is how we can scale the winners.”



You should be comfortable making decisions based on actual performance data.



Second Project – Investment Opportunity



In addition to the clothing business, we want to create a separate Google Ads campaign for an investment opportunity associated with our company.



You will be expected to:



* Understand the investment proposition.

* Help identify the appropriate target audience.

* Research relevant keywords and audiences.

* Develop appropriate campaign structures.

* Create compelling but compliant ad copy.

* Build landing-page/conversion strategies.

* Set up appropriate tracking.

* Monitor leads and conversion rates.

* Optimise the campaign based on actual results.



Important: You must understand that financial/investment advertising can be subject to Google advertising policies and applicable laws. We expect the successful candidate to work within those requirements and flag any compliance issues before launching campaigns.



We Also Want You to Teach Us



This is very important.



We don’t just want someone to manage the account for us.



We want someone who can teach us what you are doing and why you are doing it.



You should be comfortable sharing your screen with us and explaining:



* How Google Ads works.

* How to create campaigns.

* How to select products.

* How to set budgets.

* How to read campaign data.

* How to identify profitable products.

* How to optimise campaigns.

* How to scale successful campaigns.

* How to identify wasted spend.

* How to use Google Merchant Center.

* How to understand ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC and conversion rates.



We want to build a long-term working relationship where you become our Google Ads expert while also helping us become more knowledgeable ourselves.



Immediate Availability



We need someone who can start immediately.



You must be available for regular communication and be comfortable communicating through WhatsApp, Zoom/Google Meet or similar.



Initially, we would like to work closely together while the accounts are being reviewed and campaigns are built.



Requirements



You MUST have:



* At least 3 years of hands-on Google Ads experience.

* Strong experience with Google Shopping.

* Strong experience with Performance Max.

* Experience with e-commerce businesses.

* Experience advertising individual products.

* Experience with Google Merchant Center.

* Strong understanding of conversion tracking.

* Experience analysing ROAS and profitability.

* Excellent analytical skills.

* Excellent English communication skills.

* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly.

* Ability to work independently.

* Immediate availability.



Strongly Preferred



Experience with:



* Fashion/clothing e-commerce.

* Shopify or WooCommerce.

* Product feeds.

* Google Analytics 4.

* Google Tag Manager.

* Merchant Center.

* Performance Max.

* Search campaigns.

* Remarketing.

What We Expect From You



We want you to be proactive.



Don’t simply wait for us to tell you what to do.



If you see something wrong, tell us.



If you see an opportunity, tell us.

First Week Objectives

To Apply

IMPORTANT APPLICATION TEST

“I CAN START IMMEDIATELY”



Applications that do not include this sentence may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who can start immediately, produce measurable results, communicate well, and become a long-term member of our team.

Australian HVAC Company – Melbourne, Victoria



We are a growing Heating, Ventilation & Air Conditioning (HVAC) company based in Melbourne, Australia, looking for a reliable and highly organised HVAC Estimator / Quoting Assistant to join our team remotely.



Your main responsibility will be to assist our sales and operations team with preparing accurate HVAC quotations from site information, plans, photos, technician notes and supplier pricing.



This is a long-term role with the opportunity to become an important part of our estimating and sales process.



Key Responsibilities

Prepare residential and commercial HVAC quotations

Review site inspection notes, photos and floor plans

Review architectural/mechanical drawings where provided

Complete basic quantity take-offs

Order materials - design plans.

Determine materials required for HVAC installations

Prepare quotes for:

Ducted reverse-cycle air conditioning

Split-system air conditioning

Multi-split systems

Gas ducted heating replacements

Evaporative cooling

HVAC service and repair work

Calculate material and labour requirements using our pricing structure

Obtain and organise supplier pricing

Enter and prepare quotations in Simpro

Ensure quotes include the correct equipment, materials, labour and scope of works

Follow our quoting templates and pricing procedures

Identify missing information before a quote is completed

Follow up internally with our salespeople/technicians when additional information is required

Assist with quote revisions and variations

Help improve and document our estimating processes

What We're Looking For

Very strong with numbers and attention to detail

Highly organised

Able to follow detailed processes

Comfortable asking questions when information is missing

Reliable and consistent

Able to work independently

A strong English communicator

Interested in a long-term position



Previous experience in HVAC, mechanical services, construction estimating, quantity surveying, engineering, plumbing or electrical estimating would be highly regarded.



Australian construction or trade industry experience would be a major advantage.



Working Hours

Our internal estimating procedures

title: Operations Manager – U.S. Healthcare Practice | Remote  Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | U.S. Company | U.S. Business Ho
description:
Operations Manager – U.S. Healthcare Practice | Remote



Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | U.S. Company | U.S. Business Hours



About Happy Health & Nutrition



Happy Health & Nutrition (HHN) is a growing U.S.-based nutrition and health coaching company helping people create lasting health transformations through evidence-based nutrition, behavioral change, coaching, and ongoing support.



We are building HHN into a highly organized, scalable healthcare company known for an exceptional client experience, meaningful clinical partnerships, strong systems, and a team that genuinely cares about the people we serve.



At HHN, we believe compassion and accountability belong together.



We care deeply about our clients and about one another. We believe in taking ownership, continuous learning and improvement, doing meaningful work, communicating openly, following through on commitments, learning from mistakes rather than hiding them, improving the system when something does not work, holding high standards while treating people with respect, and helping people live happier, healthier lives.



We are building an A-Team of people who want to grow personally and professionally while contributing to something meaningful.



We are now looking for an experienced Operations Manager who can help turn leadership vision into consistent execution across our people, projects, systems, and client operations.



⸻



This Is NOT a Virtual Assistant Position



Please read this carefully before applying.



We are not looking for someone who waits for the CEO to provide a list of tasks, completes those tasks, and reports them back.



We need someone who can be given a desired outcome and independently determine what needs to happen next.



For example, if the CEO says:



“We need to make sure every client affected by a coach transition has been contacted, understands what is happening, and has a confirmed next appointment.”



We expect the Operations Manager to independently:



* Determine which clients are affected

* Verify what has already happened

* Identify missing or conflicting information

* Determine what still needs to happen

* Coordinate and delegate follow-up

* Establish reasonable deadlines

* Follow up when someone does not respond

* Escalate appropriately

* Verify that the work was actually completed

* Identify clients at risk of disengaging

* Recommend solutions

* Improve the process so the problem is less likely to happen again

* Report the final outcome to leadership



The CEO should not need to determine every next step.



Your role is to turn HHN’s vision into reliable execution so our coaches can focus on exceptional care, our clients feel supported throughout their entire journey, and the company can continue growing without quality being lost as we scale.



⸻



What You Will Own



You will help manage the day-to-day operational execution of HHN, including:



* Team accountability and follow-through

* Client workflow and continuity

* Operational projects and deadlines

* Staff onboarding and offboarding

* Coach transitions and client handoffs

* Project-management systems

* SOP creation, implementation, and improvement

* Making sure SOPs are actually being followed

* Evaluating whether processes are producing the intended outcome

* Maintaining operational dashboards and meaningful KPI reporting

* Identifying operational gaps before they become larger problems

* Following up with team members, contractors, vendors, and partners

* Tracking unresolved issues through completion

* Coordinating administrative team members

* Ensuring important work does not disappear inside
 or chat

* Identifying bottlenecks and recurring problems

* Recommending process improvements

* Helping leadership determine when additional team capacity or new roles are needed

* Bringing leadership solutions and recommendations, not only problems

* Helping HHN build systems that can scale beyond the Founder/CEO



As HHN continues hiring specialized team members, your role should increasingly shift from personally completing every operational task to making sure the right person owns the task and that the desired outcome is achieved.



⸻



What Excellent Performance Looks Like



You may be a strong fit if this sounds like you:



You notice when something does not make sense — and investigate it.



You do not simply send an
 or message and wait indefinitely.



You follow up. You call when appropriate. You establish deadlines. You escalate when necessary. You close loops.



If someone tells you something was completed, you understand when verification is necessary.



If a deadline may be missed, you communicate before the deadline, along with the reason and a revised plan.



If information conflicts, you do not simply report the contradiction to the CEO. You investigate and determine what actually happened.



If something repeatedly goes wrong, you do not only solve it once. You ask:



Why did this happen, and what needs to change so it does not keep happening?



You are comfortable respectfully holding people accountable.



You can distinguish between:



“This requires CEO approval.”



and



“This is an operational decision I am expected to make.”



You understand:



Task completed ≠ Outcome achieved



And when you tell us:



“I’ll take care of it.”



we should be able to trust that the loop will be closed.



⸻



The Person We Are Looking For



You are proactive without being reckless, organized without becoming rigid, kind without avoiding accountability, and confident without needing to control people.



You are curious when something goes wrong. You are comfortable asking difficult questions respectfully. You can create order from complexity, make decisions within your authority, manage several priorities simultaneously, and naturally think several steps ahead.



You care about both people and business outcomes.



You do not seek conflict, but you also do not avoid necessary conversations.



You understand that strong leadership sometimes sounds like:



“I care about you, and this expectation still needs to be met.”



HHN is a high-care, high-accountability environment.



We want someone who can protect both.



⸻



Required Qualifications



Please apply only if you have previous experience in an Operations Manager, Practice Manager, Clinic Manager, Project/Operations Manager, Team Manager, Operations Lead, or similar role where you were responsible for outcomes — not simply administrative task completion.



You should have:



* Previous experience managing people, projects, or operational outcomes

* Experience directly coordinating or supervising team members

* Strong project and deadline-management skills

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong independent judgment and problem-solving ability

* Excellent organization and follow-through

* Experience creating, documenting, and implementing SOPs

* Experience using project-management software

* Experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously

* Comfort having respectful but direct accountability conversations

* Ability to recognize when something requires escalation

* High attention to detail

* Strong confidentiality and professional judgment

* Reliable internet

* Professional remote-work environment

* Ability to work agreed-upon U.S. business hours



Strongly Preferred



Experience in one or more of the following:



* Healthcare

* Medical practices

* Nutrition or wellness companies

* Behavioral health

* Telehealth

* Client or patient service businesses

* HIPAA-regulated environments

* Managing remote teams

* Revenue-cycle or insurance-related operations

* Notion

* Microsoft Teams

* SimplePractice or another EHR/practice-management platform



Healthcare experience is valuable, but strong operational judgment is more important than knowing our exact software on Day 1.



We can teach our systems.



We are specifically looking for someone who already knows how to manage outcomes, priorities, deadlines, and people.



⸻



Compensation & Growth



Starting compensation: $800–$1,000 USD per month, depending on experience, demonstrated operational capability, schedule, and final scope of responsibility.



This is intended to be a long-term growth position.



HHN is growing, and we want the person in this role to grow with the company.



Compensation will be reviewed incrementally as you demonstrate increasing:



* Operational ownership

* Independent judgment

* Reliability

* Team-management capability

* Problem-solving ability

* Accountability leadership

* KPI and reporting competence

* Ability to manage larger areas of HHN operations

* Measurable business outcomes



Compensation growth is based on demonstrated responsibility and outcomes — not simply time in the role.



We will establish clear expectations so you understand what successful advancement requires.



As HHN continues to grow, there may also be opportunities for increased leadership responsibility for a candidate who consistently demonstrates the ability to operate at a higher level.



We do not promise automatic promotions or salary increases.



We do promise that strong performance, increasing responsibility, and meaningful contribution will be recognized.



⸻



This Position May NOT Be Right for You If:



* You prefer receiving detailed step-by-step instructions for most assignments

* You are uncomfortable following up repeatedly when something important remains unresolved

* You avoid difficult conversations even when expectations are not being met

* You prefer completing tasks over taking responsibility for final outcomes

* You regularly wait for your supervisor to determine the next step

* You struggle to prioritize when several things are happening simultaneously

* You consider sending an
 or message the completion of a responsibility even when the desired outcome has not occurred

* You are uncomfortable working in a growing company where systems will continue improving and evolving



There is nothing wrong with those working styles.



They are simply not the working style required for this position.



⸻



How to Apply



Please do not submit only a generic cover letter.



We care significantly more about how you think than how polished your résumé sounds.



At the beginning of your application, write:



I OWN THE OUTCOME



Then submit your résumé and answer the questions below.



Question 1 — Operations Scenario



You are the Operations Manager for a healthcare coaching company.



A coach returns from an extended leave and approximately 12 previous clients are transferred back to her.



Two weeks later, the CEO discovers that the coach saw only two clients during the previous week.



The coach reports that she contacted several clients.



However, some information does not match what the company is hearing directly from clients, and there is no clear central record showing who was contacted, when they were contacted, how many attempts were made, who responded, who has a future appointment, and who may be at risk of leaving the company.



The CEO tells you:



“The desired outcome is that every client has a verified status, no client unintentionally falls through the cracks, and we recover as many client relationships as possible.”



What would you do next?



Please walk us through your approach step by step, including:



1. What you would investigate first

2. What information you would gather

3. Who you would communicate with

4. What you would delegate

5. What deadlines you would establish

6. What you would do if someone did not respond

7. What you would d
 independently versus bring to the CEO

8. How you would verify that the desired outcome was actually achieved

9. What you would change operationally to reduce the likelihood of this happening again



There is no required response length.



We are evaluating how you think, not whether you guess our current process correctly.



Question 2 — Leadership & Culture Scenario



At HHN, we believe that caring deeply about people and maintaining high standards are not opposites.



Tell us about a real situation where someone you worked with was repeatedly not meeting an important expectation.



Please explain what was happening, how you approached the person, what you said or did, how you balanced accountability with respect, what happened afterward, and what you learned.



We are especially interested in understanding how you handle situations where addressing the problem may feel uncomfortable.



Final Question



In 3–5 sentences, answer:



What do you believe is the difference between completing a task and owning an outcome?



Applications that do not include the required questions may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants to help build something meaningful, enjoys solving complicated problems, and takes pride in making an organization work better because they are part of it.



If that sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.
